title: Conditional abelianity for special half-weight fourfold pairs

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Assume the manifold abelianity conjecture for special compact Kähler manifolds in the precise form Assumption ass:manifold of the cited paper. If X is a smooth connected projective complex fourfold and D a nonempty smooth connected reduced divisor whose square-root stack sqrt[2](X,D) is special, must $\pi _{1}(X$ minus D) modulo the normal closure of the square of a positive meridian around D be virtually abelian?

title: Existence of a finite ordinary Kähler fourfold program

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a normal globally Weil-Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold X with rational klt boundary $\Delta $, does there exist an ordinary negative program starting exactly on X and ending nef for pseudo-effective $K_X+\Delta $, or in a projective relative-Picard-one Mori contraction otherwise, preserving klt and global Weil Q-factoriality and not extracting primes? The composite must not decrease discrepancies and must strictly improve those of contracted X-primes.

title: Generalized-canonical flip termination on Kähler fourfolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Fix a normal globally Weil-Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold, rational boundary coefficients in [0,1), and nef rational b-Cartier data on a projective birational Kähler model. Assume generalized discrepancies are positive for all primes and at least one for exceptional primes. Must every sequence of nontrivial projective small rational-adjoint flips, preserving these canonical and b-data, be finite?

title: Generalized Hodge support on CM abelian varieties

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let A be any complex CM abelian variety and let $W\subset H^k(A,Q)$ be a rational Hodge substructure. If W(r) is effective for $r\geq 0$, must W vanish on the complement of some closed algebraic subset of A of codimension at least r? Products and powers of CM abelian varieties are included.

title: Generalized lc flip termination on Kähler fourfolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: On globally Weil-Q-factorial normal compact Kähler fourfolds, fix effective rational boundary and a nef rational b-Cartier divisor represented on a projective birational Kähler model, with the generalized pair lc. Must every sequence of existing projective small connected-fiber flips for this same rational adjoint and b-data terminate? Each flipping adjoint is negative ample, and its next transform positive ample.

title: Minimal or Mori models for generalized rational lc pairs

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, does every normal integral projective generalized log canonical rational pair \((X,B+M)\), with fixed nef rational b-Cartier data, have a projective birational model \(Y\) extracting no divisor, on which generalized discrepancies do not decrease and increase strictly for contracted prime divisors on \(X\)? The adjoint on \(Y\) must be nef if the original adjoint is pseudo-effective. Otherwise \(Y\) must have a contraction with connected fibres to a lower-dimensional normal projective base, relative Picard number one, and relatively antiample adjoint. The traces on both models must come from the same fixed nef b-divisor.

title: The generalized Mukai pseudoindex assertion

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every smooth connected complex projective Fano $n$-fold $X$ with $n>0$, Picard number $\rho$, and pseudoindex $\iota=\min\{-K_X\cdot C:C\text{ is a rational curve}\}$, is $\rho(\iota-1)\leq n$, with equality exactly when $X$ is the product of $\rho$ copies of $\mathbb{P}^{\iota-1}$?

title: Gepner-type numerical stability on quintic threefolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every smooth complex quintic $X\subset P^{4}$, is there a locally finite numerical Bridgeland stability condition (Z,P) with the full numerical support property, normalized by $Z(O_x)=-1$ for each point, such that $\Phi =T_{O_X}\circ (-\otimes O_X(1))$ sends $P(\varphi )$ to $P(\varphi +2/5)$ and $Z(\Phi E)=\exp (2\pi i/5)Z(E)$?

title: Rational Hodge classes on CM abelian varieties

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: On every complex abelian variety of CM type, is each rational class in $H^{2p}$ of Hodge type (p,p) the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle? All p and all finite products and powers of CM abelian varieties are included.

title: Hodge support on a specified K3 quadratic locus

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let S be a smooth projective complex K3 surface whose transcendental quadratic space, with its cup form, embeds isometrically over Q in $U_Q\oplus U_Q\oplus \langle -1\rangle ^{4}$. For every $m\geq 1$, are all rational (p,p) classes on $S^m$ algebraic, and is every rational Hodge substructure with Hodge coniveau at least r supported on an algebraic subset of codimension at least r? U denotes the hyperbolic plane.

title: Hodge classes on generic abelian-cover Jacobian powers

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Fix a connected topological finite abelian cover of a compact oriented surface, allowing arbitrary base genus and branching with nontrivial branch meridians. Vary the full marked complex base structure and all branch positions. At a parameter s where each rational even tensor in marked $H^{1}$ that becomes a Hodge tensor was already Hodge throughout this variation, must every rational Hodge class on $(Jac(C_s)×M)^N$ be algebraic for every CM abelian variety M and every $N\geq 1$? The same s must work for all M.

title: Hodge classes on diagonal complete-intersection powers

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Fix $n\geq 2$, $d\geq 0$ and $c\in {0,1,2}$, set $m=d+c+1$, and let A be a rank-c matrix all of whose maximal coordinate minors are nonzero. In $P^{m-1}$, define $X_A$ by $\Sigma _i$ $a_{\alpha i}x_i^n=0$ for $1\leq \alpha \leq c$. Outside a countable union of proper algebraic subsets of this smooth labelled parameter space, must every rational Hodge class on every $X_A^u$, $u\geq 1$, be algebraic? For $c\leq 1$ or $d=0$, the assertion is required at every smooth parameter.

title: Hodge classes on powers of split Weil sixfolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Suppose a complex abelian sixfold A has an imaginary-quadratic-field action and a compatible polarization whose rational Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature (3,3). Does every rational Hodge class on $A^m$ come from a rational algebraic cycle, for every positive m and every codimension?

title: Rational Hodge classes on products of K3 surfaces

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For any finite nonempty list of projective complex K3 surfaces $S_{1},\dots ,S_m$, does every rational cohomology class of type (p,p) on their product arise as the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle, for each integer $0\leq p\leq 2m$?

title: Kähler fourfold abundance after nonvanishing

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a normal connected compact Kähler fourfold with effective rational klt boundary $\Delta $, let $D=K_X+\Delta $ be Q-Cartier and analytically nef. If $\kappa (X,D)\geq 0$, must the actual adjoint have a globally generated positive Cartier multiple? When $\kappa =0$, must some positive multiple be the trivial line?

title: B-semiampleness for compact Kähler log-smooth fibrations

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be surjective with connected fibers between smooth connected compact Kähler manifolds. Let $\Delta $ be effective rational SNC with coefficients in [0,1] and $K_Y+\Delta $ Q-linearly equal to f*L for $L\in Pic(X)\otimes Q$. Is the canonical-bundle-formula moduli rational line b-semiample: on some smooth Kähler modification $S\to X$, does it become a globally generated line after a positive integral multiple, and pull back as the same rational line on every subsequent smooth modification?

title: Numerical semiampleness of Kähler adjoints

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let X be smooth connected compact Kähler, B effective rational SNC with coefficients below one, and M a nef rational holomorphic line. If $K_X+B$ is pseudo-effective and $D=K_X+B+M$ is nef, must some semiample rational holomorphic line L have $c_{1}(L)=c_{1}(D)$ in real Bott–Chern cohomology? Actual semiampleness of D is not required.

title: A geometric criterion for Kuga–Satake algebraicity

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let (S,h) be a primitively amply polarized projective complex K3 surface. Put $V=h\perp $ in $H^{2}(S,Q)$, with its primitive quadratic Hodge structure, and assume $Hg(V)=SO(V,q)$, so $T(S)=V$. Are the following three conditions equivalent? First, some rational codimension-two correspondence from S to a complex abelian variety acts nontrivially on V. Second, there is a smooth connected projective surface Y and a dominant generically finite morphism $f:Y\to S$ such that tracing the wedge products of holomorphic one-forms on Y to $H^{0}(S,\Omega ^{2}_S)$ gives a nonzero map. Third, for every specified standard full Kuga–Satake Clifford, polarization and realization datum, a rational codimension-two cycle induces the prescribed Kuga–Satake map on $T(S)=V$.

title: Numerical-dimension-one log abundance in characteristic above three

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Over any algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, must the rational Cartier adjoint $K_X+B$ of every normal projective lc threefold pair with effective rational boundary be semiample whenever it is nef and has numerical dimension one?

title: Logarithmic Kodaira additivity under stratum smoothness

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a connected-fiber surjective morphism of smooth connected projective complex varieties. Let E and D be reduced SNC divisors on X and Y with $Supp(f*D)\subset Supp(E)$. Assume f and every boundary stratum of E are smooth over Y minus Supp(D). For a very general fiber F with $E_F=E|F$, must $\kappa (X,K_X+E)=\kappa (Y,K_Y+D)+\kappa (F,K_F+E_F)$, with $-\infty $ absorbing in the sum?

title: Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in higher complex dimension

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For each smooth connected projective complex n-fold X of $n\geq 3$ and ample line L, does there exist $r_{0}(X,L)$ such that for all $r\geq r_{0}$, the multipoint Seshadri constant at very general distinct r-tuples is $(L^n/r)^{1/n}$?

title: Generic maximal Seshadri constants in positive characteristic

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Over any algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, for a smooth projective geometrically integral n-fold X with $n\geq 3$ and ample L, does some $r_{0}(X,L)$ guarantee $\varepsilon (L;x_{1},\dots ,x_r)=(L^n/r)^{1/n}$ at the geometric generic ordered tuple for every $r\geq r_{0}$?

title: Rational effectivity modulo a controlled boundary

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let Y be smooth projective complex of positive dimension and C an effective integral divisor. If $-K_Y+C$ has a singular Hermitian metric whose curvature dominates a Kähler form and whose multiplier ideal contains $O_Y(-C)$, must every pseudo-effective rational divisor M admit an effective rational correction $C_{0}$ supported on C such that $M+C_{0}$ is Q-linearly equal to an effective rational divisor?

title: Topological right-triviality of constant-Milnor surface families

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let F(x,t) be holomorphic near ${0}×\Delta $ in $C^{3}×\Delta $, with $f_t(0)=0$ and an isolated critical point at zero in each fiber, and with constant Milnor number. After shrinking representatives and the disk, must there be a jointly continuous homeomorphism germ $\Phi (x,t)=(\varphi _t(x),t)$, with continuous inverse, $\varphi _t(0)=0$ and $\varphi _{0}=id$, satisfying $f_t(\varphi _t(x))=f_{0}(x)$?

title: Polynomiality of the natural invariant anticanonical index

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let a compact real torus T act holomorphically on a compact complex manifold F and linearize $L=-K_F$ by the differential action. Put $I_T(m)=\Sigma _q(-1)^q$ dim $H^q(F,L^m)^T$. Must some positive a and rational polynomial P satisfy $I_T(m)=P(m)$ for every positive multiple of a, with $P(0)=I_T(0)$? No positivity or projectivity is assumed.

title: Zero Lelong numbers for minimal metrics on nef adjoints

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a normal connected projective complex klt pair $(H,\Theta )$ with effective rational $\Theta $ and nef Q-Cartier $D=K_H+\Theta $, does every semipositive singular Hermitian metric with minimal singularities on $\pi *D$ have zero Lelong number at every point, for every projective log resolution $\pi :V\to H$? Existence of such a minimal metric is included; $K_H$ and $\Theta $ need not separately be Q-Cartier.

title: The Oka property for every complex K3 surface

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For any complex K3 surface X with any smooth Hermitian distance, any $m\geq 1$, nonempty compact convex $K\subset C^m$, neighborhood U of K and holomorphic $f:U\to X$, can f be approximated on K to arbitrary uniform accuracy by a holomorphic map $C^m\to X$? Nonprojective K3 surfaces are included. This is the convex approximation form of the Oka property.

title: The ordinary-double-point normalized-volume gap

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For any singular point x on a normal complex algebraic n-fold, $n\geq 2$, with zero boundary, Q-Cartier $K_X$ and klt singularities near x, must the normalized volume be at most $2(n-1)^n$, attaining that value exactly for the analytic germ of $\Sigma _{i=0}^n$ $z_i^{2}=0$?

title: The four-dimensional normalized-volume gap

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: At a singular point of a normal complex algebraic fourfold with zero boundary and Q-Cartier canonical divisor that is klt nearby, must normalized volume be at most 162, with equality exactly for the analytic ordinary quadratic double point in $C^{5}$?

title: Virasoro constraints for projective complete intersections

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every smooth complete intersection X in complex projective space, does its ordinary unreduced total descendant potential satisfy every Virasoro constraint in every genus and curve class, allowing arbitrary complex cohomology insertions?

title: Completeness of original Pixton relations on closed moduli

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every stable (g,n), do the original Pixton dual-graph relations, together with their pullbacks and pushforwards, generate the entire kernel of the strata-algebra map to $R*(Mbar_{g,n})$? Only closed moduli are asserted; compact-type and rational-tail completeness are separate.

title: Prescribed large-volume stability charges on threefolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let X be any smooth projective complex threefold with $K_X$ trivial. For each real $B_*$ and ample $H_*$ in $N^{1}(X)$, do neighborhoods V,W and one $T>0$ exist such that for all $B\in V,H\in W,t\geq T$, the exact central charge $-\int _X$ $\exp (-B-itH)ch(E)\operatorname{sqrt}(td(X))$ occurs in a geometric numerical Bridgeland stability condition with support on the full numerical K group?

title: Bases of projective Lagrangian fibrations

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For $n\geq 1$, let X be a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold of dimension 2n and $f:X\to B$ a projective surjective holomorphic map with connected fibers to a normal projective n-fold. If every irreducible component of every fiber has dimension n and its smooth locus is isotropic for the symplectic form, must B be isomorphic to $P^n$?

title: Numerical semiampleness of projective adjoints

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a projective rational klt pair (X,B) over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, assume $K_X+B$ is pseudo-effective and M is a nef rational Cartier divisor. If $D=K_X+B+M$ is nef, must D be numerically equivalent to some semiample rational Cartier divisor?

title: P=W for fixed-determinant trace-free coprime moduli

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a smooth connected projective complex curve of genus at least two, any composite rank $r\geq 4$ and degree d coprime to r, fix a degree-d determinant L. Under nonabelian Hodge correspondence between stable trace-free L-determinant Higgs moduli and its twisted $SL_r$ character variety, does the Hitchin perverse filtration $P_k$ equal $W_{2k}=W_{2k+1}$ on rational cohomology in every degree?

title: Split tangents on rationally connected projective manifolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a smooth connected rationally connected complex projective X with holomorphic $T_X=V_{1}\oplus V_{2}$, must both summands be integrable and X be biholomorphic to a product whose two factor tangents correspond to the given summands?

title: Schnell’s fiber-space assertion in Kodaira dimension zero

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a connected-fiber surjective morphism $f:X\to Y$ of smooth connected projective complex varieties with smooth geometric generic fiber F of $\kappa (F)=0$, suppose $m_{0}K_X-f*H$ is pseudo-effective for some $m_{0}>0$ and ample Cartier H on Y. Must $\kappa (X)=dim$ Y?

title: Symmetry of bounded semialgebraic domains with compact quotient

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let U be nonempty connected semialgebraic bounded open in a complex affine variety. If a group of biholomorphisms acts properly discontinuously and U has compact quotient, must U be smooth and biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain?

title: Classification of semialgebraic projective universal covers

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a connected normal projective complex variety X, is its universal cover biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety exactly when it is $D×C^m×F$, where $m\geq 0$, D is a bounded symmetric domain, and F is simply connected normal projective? Point factors are allowed and deck transformations need not be algebraic.

title: Removing a fixed pseudo-effective anticanonical error

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let S be smooth connected projective complex and let $L=-K_S$ carry a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric. For any pseudo-effective Cartier divisor D, if $H^{0}(S,m_j$ $L-D)\neq 0$ for a strictly increasing sequence of positive $m_j$, must $H^{0}(S,kL)\neq 0$ for some positive k?

title: Invariant anticanonical sections under structure-sheaf acyclicity

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a smooth connected projective complex X with smoothly semipositive $-K_X$ and $H^i(X,O_X)=0$ for all $i>0$, must every algebraic torus action admit a nonzero invariant section of some positive anticanonical power with its natural linearization?

title: Invariant anticanonical sections with nonzero Euler characteristic

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let X be smooth connected projective complex with smoothly semipositive $-K_X$ and $\chi (X,O_X)\neq 0$. For any algebraic torus T acting on X with the natural anticanonical linearization, must some positive anticanonical multiple have a nonzero T-invariant global section?

title: Anticanonical nonvanishing from smooth semipositivity

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every smooth connected projective complex X, if $-K_X$ admits a smooth Hermitian metric with semipositive Chern curvature, must $H^{0}(X,-mK_X)\neq 0$ for some positive integer m?

title: Two-step linear images of special quasi-projective groups

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every connected smooth special complex quasi-projective variety V, every $d\geq 1$ and every representation $\rho :\pi _{1}(V)\to GL_d(C)$, must its image have a finite-index subgroup nilpotent of class at most two? The assertion concerns representation images, not virtual nilpotence of $\pi _{1}(V)$ itself.

title: Universal-cover products for integrable tangent summands

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let X be a connected compact Kähler manifold with $T_X=V_{1}\oplus V_{2}$ a decomposition into holomorphic integrable subbundles. Must its universal cover split biholomorphically as $Y_{1}×Y_{2}$ so that the lifted $V_i$ is the tangent bundle along the corresponding factor?

title: Lifting an adjoint section from its reduced support

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Let (V,C) be a normal projective Q-factorial dlt pair in characteristic zero with effective rational C, and put $A=K_V+C$. Suppose a nonzero effective Cartier divisor G is linearly equal to qA for a sufficiently divisible positive q and $Supp(G)\subset Supp(\lfloor C\rfloor )$. If $O_V(G)$ restricted to $G_red$ is semiample, must $\kappa (V,A)>0$?

title: Tate classes on finite-field abelian varieties

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement:
Let $A/\mathbb F_q$ be an abelian variety, let $r\geq0$, and let $\ell$ be a prime different from the characteristic. Is the cycle-class map
\[\operatorname{CH}^r(A)\otimes\mathbb Q_\ell\longrightarrow H_{\mathrm{et}}^{2r}(A_{\overline{\mathbb F}_q},\mathbb Q_\ell(r))^{\operatorname{Gal}(\overline{\mathbb F}_q/\mathbb F_q)}\]
surjective? For algebraic cycles with rational coefficients on $A_{\overline{\mathbb F}_q}$, do numerical equivalence and $\ell$-adic homological equivalence coincide?

title: Terminal numerical-dimension-one abundance in positive characteristic

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For a normal projective Q-factorial terminal threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, if $K_X$ is nef with $\nu (K_X)=1$, must some positive Cartier multiple have at least two independent sections, so that $\kappa (K_X)=1$ and $K_X$ is semiample?

title: Uniform Cartier-section thresholds for Fano-type contractions

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every $d>0$ and real $\varepsilon >0$, does $\tau (d,\varepsilon )>0$ exist such that each $\varepsilon -lc$ rational d-dimensional pair (X,B), Fano-type contraction $f:X\to Z$ of normal integral quasi-projective varieties with dim $Z>0$ and relatively nef $-(K_X+B)$, and closed $z\in Z$ admits a neighborhood U and nonzero effective Cartier D on U through z with $(f^-1(U),B+\tau $ f*D) lc? Fields are algebraically closed of characteristic zero.

title: Uniform effective log-Iitaka systems for fourfolds

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: Given finite $\Phi \subset [0,1]\cap Q$, does some positive $m(\Phi )$ make $|\lfloor m(K_X+\Delta )\rfloor |$ nonempty and make its ratios generate the full Iitaka field for every normal integral projective complex lc fourfold $(X,\Delta )$ with effective rational boundary coefficients in $\Phi $ and rational Cartier pseudo-effective $K_X+\Delta $? The same m must work for every chosen canonical divisor.

title: Uniform log-Iitaka systems with fixed coefficients

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For each $d\geq 5$ and finite $\Phi \subset [0,1]\cap Q$, does one $m(d,\Phi )>0$ work for every normal integral projective lc d-fold (X,B) over any algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, with nonzero B coefficients in $\Phi $, rational Cartier $D=K_X+B$ and $\kappa (D)\geq 0$, so that $H^{0}(X,O_X(\lfloor mD\rfloor ))$ is nonzero and its ratios generate the entire Iitaka field K(D) inside k(X)?

title: A uniform pluricanonical Iitaka degree

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For each $d\geq 1$, does there exist a positive m(d) such that $|m(d)K_X|$ gives the entire Iitaka fibration of every smooth integral projective d-fold of nonnegative Kodaira dimension over every algebraically closed characteristic-zero field? The ratios must generate the Iitaka field, rather than merely attain its transcendence degree.

title: Unramified de Rham quantum Langlands at irrational level

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For every smooth connected projective complex curve X and connected simple complex group G with specified full root datum, lacing number r and Langlands dual $G\vee $, fix dual pinnings and a theta characteristic. Define $D_c(Bun_G)$ as the presentable derived category of all D-modules twisted by the adjoint determinant line to exponent $(c-h\vee )/(2h\vee )$. For each $c\in C$ outside Q, is there a C-linear DG equivalence $D_c(Bun_G(X))\simeq D_(-1/(rc))(Bun_{G\vee }(X))$, using all connected components and compatible with localization–Whittaker comparison, moving-point collisions and the corresponding central-torsor/transgression actions?

title: Virasoro propagation through projective bundles

category.name: algebraic_geometry
category.description: Geometric objects defined by polynomial equations.

statement: For any smooth connected projective complex variety B and algebraic vector bundle E of rank at least two, if all ordinary descendant Virasoro constraints hold for B in every genus, curve class and cohomology insertion, must they also hold for the projective bundle of lines $P_B(E)$?

title: Deterministic polynomial construction of strong thin spanning trees

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Is there an absolute C and a deterministic algorithm polynomial in total binary input length that, on every k-edge-connected finite loopless multigraph (parallel-edge multiplicities allowed), returns a spanning tree T with |T intersect $\delta (S)|<=C|\delta (S)|/k$ for every vertex cut S?

title: Barker-sequence length conjecture

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Must every \{-1,1\} sequence of length $n>13$ have a nonzero-shift aperiodic autocorrelation with absolute value greater than one?

title: Borsuk covering assertion in dimension nine

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Can every bounded subset S of $R^9$ with positive diameter be covered by at most ten subsets, each having diameter strictly smaller than diam(S)?

title: Bounded-degree coboundary expanders in each dimension at least three

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every integer $d>=3$, do constants $D,\epsilon >0$ and connected pure finite d-dimensional simplicial complexes with vertex counts tending to infinity exist such that each vertex belongs to at most D top faces and every $F_2$ cochain below top dimension satisfies ||delta $f||>=\epsilon $ dist(f,B)?

title: Circulant Hadamard conjecture

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: If a real n-by-n circulant matrix with entries in \{-1,1\} satisfies H $H^T=n$ I, must n belong to \{1,4\}?

title: Logarithmic correspondence-coloring bound for fixed forbidden cliques

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For each fixed $r>=4$, do constants $C_r,Delta_r$ exist such that every finite $K_r-subgraph-free$ graph of maximum degree $Delta>=Delta_r$ has correspondence chromatic number at most $ceil(C_r$ Delta/log Delta)?

title: Colin de Verdière chromatic-number conjecture

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Does every finite simple graph G satisfy $chi(G)<=\mu (G)+1$, where mu is the Colin de Verdière invariant?

title: Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For each fixed integer $d>=3$, is there a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, for every sufficiently large even n, constructs a simple connected nonbipartite d-regular graph on n vertices with all nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues of absolute value at most 2 sqrt(d-1)?

title: Fractional chromatic number versus ordinary Hadwiger number

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every finite simple graph G, is its fractional chromatic number $chi_f(G)$ at most h(G), the largest order of a complete minor?

title: Gopalan–Servedio square-root-degree Fourier bound

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Is there an absolute constant C such that every nonconstant Boolean $f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}$ satisfies $sum_i$ $|f_hat({i})|<=C$ sqrt(deg(f)), where deg(f) is its exact real multilinear degree?

title: Shareshian–Wachs elementary positivity for chromatic quasisymmetric functions

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every natural unit interval graph G on its natural labels, does its chromatic quasisymmetric function $chi_G(X;q)$ have every coefficient in the elementary symmetric-function basis in N[q]?

title: Graph decomposition at the integral expectation threshold

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Are there universal constants k and L such that every graph H on at most n vertices has an edge partition into k fixed pieces $H_i$ whose random-graph containment thresholds $p_c(H_i;n)$ are at most L times the integral expectation threshold q(H;n)?

title: Log-squared sharp threshold for monotone graph properties

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Does one absolute C bound $p_{1-\epsilon }-p_\epsilon $ by C log(1/(2 epsilon))/(log $n)^2$ for every nonempty proper increasing vertex-relabeling-invariant graph property on $n>=2$ vertices and every epsilon in (0,1/2)?

title: Power improvement for planar halving lines

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Do absolute constants $\epsilon >0$ and C exist such that every even n and every n-point planar set in general position determine at most C $n^{4/3-\epsilon }$ lines that leave exactly (n-2)/2 other points on each side?

title: Power improvement over exponent two in Heilbronn triangle constructions

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Do absolute $\eta ,c>0$ exist such that for every sufficiently large n there is a set of n points in the unit square for which every triangle has area at least c $n^{-2+\eta }$?

title: Optimal-order distinct distances in every dimension at least three

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For each fixed integer $d>=3$, does there exist $c_d>0$ such that every set of $n>=2$ distinct points in $R^d$ determines at least $c_d$ $n^{2/d}$ different Euclidean distances?

title: Uniform variance-influence bound for hypergraph properties

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For each fixed $r>=3$, does $C_r$ exist such that for every $n>=r$, every p in (0,1), and every Boolean property of r-uniform hypergraphs invariant under vertex relabeling, $Var_p(f)<=C_r$ $I_p(f)/(\log $ $n)^(r/(r-1))$?

title: Integral and fractional expectation thresholds within a constant factor

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Does one absolute constant C satisfy $q_f(F)<=C$ q(F) for every nonempty proper increasing family F on an arbitrary finite ground set, where integral and fractional covers both use cost budget one half?

title: Degree-uniform power saving for intersective polynomial differences

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For each $k>=2$, is there $c_k>0$ such that for every intersective h in Z[x] of degree k with positive leading coefficient, all sufficiently large N and all A subset [N] avoiding nonzero h(t) differences for positive integers t satisfy $|A|<=C_h$ $N^{1-c_k}$, with $C_h$ allowed to depend on h?

title: Polynomial induced removal for ordered binary matrices

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every fixed binary matrix H, do positive constants c,C exist such that every n-by-n binary matrix at normalized entry-edit distance at least epsilon from H-freeness contains at least C $\epsilon ^c$ $n^(rows(H)+columns(H))$ induced ordered copies of H?

title: Periodic tilings by bounded measurable sets in three dimensions

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: If a bounded measurable set of positive volume in $R^3$ tiles $R^3$ by translations up to measure-zero overlaps, must some such tiling have its translation set invariant under a full-rank lattice?

title: Periodic translational tiling in dimension three

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: If a finite nonempty T subset $Z^3$ tiles $Z^3$ by translations, must it admit a translation tiling whose translation set is invariant under some finite-index subgroup of $Z^3$?

title: Five-colorability of the unit-distance plane

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Does there exist a map $c:R^2->{1,2,3,4,5}$ such that $c(x)!=c(y)$ whenever $||x-y||=1$, with arbitrary color classes and ordinary ZFC?

title: Power saving for prime-intersective polynomial differences

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every h in Z[x] of degree at least two with positive leading coefficient and a unit root modulo every positive integer, do $c_h,C_h>0$ exist such that every A subset [N] avoiding the nonzero values h(p) for rational primes p as differences satisfies $|A|<=C_h$ $N^{1-c_h}$?

title: Quasipolynomial density decay for progression-free sets

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every fixed integer $k>=3$, do constants $C_k,c_k,\epsilon _k>0$ exist such that every subset A of \{1,...,N\} containing no nonconstant k-term arithmetic progression has $|A|<=C_k$ N $\exp (-c_k$ (log $N)^\epsilon _k)$ for every $N>=2$?

title: Sharp logarithmic exponents for fixed off-diagonal Ramsey numbers

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every fixed integer $s>=5$ and every $\epsilon >0$, is r(s,t) bounded below by $t^{s-1}/(\log $ $t)^{s-2+\epsilon }$ for all sufficiently large t and above by $C_s$ $t^{s-1}/(\log $ $t)^{s-2}$, for a constant $C_s$ depending only on s?

title: Maker winning strategy for Snaky on the infinite square lattice

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement:
In the unbiased Maker–Breaker game on the initially empty lattice $\mathbb Z^2$, can Maker force the six-cell Snaky polyomino
\[\{(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(3,1),(4,1)\}\]
up to translation, rotation or reflection against every legal Breaker strategy?

title: Talagrand discrete convexity conjecture

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Is there a universal integer $k$ such that, for every finite $X$, every $p\in(0,1)$, and every $D\subseteq2^X$ of $p$-biased measure at least $1-1/k$, the sets $S\subseteq X$ that are not contained in any union of $k$ members of $D$ have a cover $G$ with $\sum_{I\in G}p^{|I|}\leq1/2$, meaning that each such $S$ contains a member of $G$?

title: Sharp terminal edge count in random triangle removal

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For the process that repeatedly removes the three edges of a uniformly selected remaining triangle from $K_n$ until triangle-free, does the final edge count $F_n$ satisfy $E[(F_n/n^{3/2}-1/(2$ $\operatorname{sqrt}(2)))^2]->0$?

title: Power improvement over the planar unit-distance exponent four thirds

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: Do absolute constants $\epsilon >0$ and $C>0$ exist such that every n-point set in $R^2$ has at most C $n^{4/3-\epsilon }$ unordered pairs at Euclidean distance one?

title: Weak pinned planar distance assertion

category.name: combinatorics
category.description: Counting problems, graph theory, discrete structures.

statement: For every $\epsilon >0$ and $\delta >0$, does $N_0$ exist such that every planar set P of $N>=N_0$ distinct points has at most delta N points x with fewer than $N^{1-\epsilon }$ distinct positive distances to the other points of P?

title: Triangular-cylinder approximation of aligned radial sweeps

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement:
Let $P\subset\mathbb R^3$ be a two-dimensional vector plane with unit normal $e$, and take linearly independent $a,b\in P$. Let $J=[\alpha,\beta]$ with $\alpha<\beta$, let $R:J\to[0,\infty)$ be continuous, let $w:J\to P$ be continuously differentiable, and fix $p_0\in P$ and $L>0$. Suppose $w'(t)=\lambda(t)(a+tb)$ for a continuous real function $\lambda$. Define
\[
 S=\{p_0+\rho(a+tb)+s(e+w(t)):t\in J,\ 0\le\rho\le R(t),\ |s|\le L\}.
\]
For every finite tagged partition of $J$, can one cover the part of $S$ over each partition interval by a compact cylinder having a nondegenerate triangular base and axis $e+w(\text{tag})$, with the sum of the base areas perpendicular to their respective axes converging to
\[
 |\det_P(a,b)|\int_\alpha^\beta
 \frac{R(t)^2}{2\sqrt{1+\lVert w(t)\rVert^2}}\,dt
\]
uniformly over all partitions and tags as the mesh tends to zero?

title: Half-minimum-area bound for cylinder covers

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: If finitely many cylinders $B_i+R$ $u_i$ cover a convex body $K\subset R^{3}$, with unit axes $u_i$ and measurable perpendicular bases $B_i\subset u_i\perp $ of finite area, must $\Sigma _i$ $area(B_i)\geq \tfrac12 $ $min_{|u|=1}area(proj_{u\perp }K)$? Costs are counted with multiplicity and base convexity is not required.

title: Linear coefficient of minimum spherical logarithmic energy

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For ordered-pair logarithmic energy $E_{\log} (N)=min_{x_{1},\dots ,x_N\in S^{2}}$ $-\Sigma _{i\neq j}\log \Vert x_i-x_j\Vert $, is $E_{\log} (N)=(\tfrac12 -\log 2)N^{2}-\tfrac12 N$ logN+C N+o(N), where $C=2\log 2+\tfrac12 \log (2/3)+3\log (\surd \pi /\Gamma (1/3))$, as integers N tend to infinity? Collisions have infinite energy and distances are ambient Euclidean chords.

title: Binary edit distance has exponential-scale L1 distortion

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Do absolute $c>0,d_{0}$ exist such that, for every integer $d\geq d_{0}$, some common word length $1\leq n\leq d$ and finite $W\subset {0,1}^{n}$ with at least two words have least $L^{1}$ distortion at least $\exp (c\surd (\log $ d loglog d)) for ordinary unit-cost insertion, deletion and substitution edit distance?

title: Uniform L1 distortion for bounded treewidth

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each positive integer k, does a finite C(k) bound the $L^{1}$ embedding distortion of all finite connected graphs with positive real edge lengths and a tree decomposition having at most k vertices per bag? The constant is independent of graph size and lengths, and embeddings may use an arbitrary real $L^{1}$ target and positive scale.

title: Simplex maximum for projection-body volume

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every $n\geq 3$ and convex body $K\subset R^{n}$, must $|\Pi K|/|K|^{n-1}$ be at most the corresponding value for an n-simplex? The projection body $\Pi K$ has support function $h_{\Pi K}(u)=vol_{n-1}(proj_{u\perp }K)$ for unit u. No symmetry or regularity is assumed.

title: Directionwise normalized cylinder-covering bound

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: If finitely many cylinders $B_i+R$ $u_i$ cover a convex body $K\subset R^{3}$, with unit axes and measurable finite-area perpendicular bases, must $\Sigma _i$ $area(B_i)/area(proj_{u_i\perp }K)\geq \tfrac12 $? No symmetry assumption is imposed and costs have multiplicity.

title: Sharp exponential scale of edit-distance distortion

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Do absolute $c,C>0$ and $d_{0}$ exist such that, for all $d\geq d_{0}$ and every finite alphabet $\Sigma $ with at least two symbols, the least $L^{1}$ embedding distortion of all words of length at most d with unit-cost insertion, deletion and substitution distance lies between $\exp (c\surd (\log $ d loglog d)) and $\exp (C\surd (\log $ d loglog d))? The constants must be uniform over alphabets and the domain includes the empty word.

title: One signing for all Euclidean prefixes

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Does an absolute C exist such that every finite prescribed-order sequence $v_{1},\dots ,v_N$ in the Euclidean unit ball of $R^{d}$ admits one signing $\varepsilon _i\in {-1,1}$ for which $max_{0\leq k\leq N}\Vert \Sigma _{i\leq k}\varepsilon _i$ $v_i\Vert _{2}\leq C\surd d$? No zero-total condition is assumed, and signs may depend on the whole sequence.

title: Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström bound

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Does an absolute C exist such that, for all $d,N\geq 1$ and every indexed family $v_{1},\dots ,v_N$ in the Euclidean unit ball of $R^{d}$ with $\Sigma _i$ $v_i=0$, a permutation $\pi $ satisfies $max_{0\leq k\leq N}\Vert \Sigma _{i\leq k}v_(\pi (i))\Vert _{2}\leq C\surd d$? Repetitions and zeros are permitted, and the same C must be independent of N.

title: Gaussian propeller partition bound

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every $d,k\geq 1$ and measurable partition $A_{1},\dots ,A_k$ of $R^{d}$, must $\Sigma _i\Vert \int _{A_i}x$ $d\gamma _d(x)\Vert ^{2}\leq 9/(8\pi )$, where $\gamma _d$ is standard Gaussian probability? Empty cells and arbitrary cell masses are allowed. For $d\geq 2,k\geq 3$, is the bound attained by three planar sectors of angle $2\pi /3$ times their orthogonal complement, with remaining cells empty?

title: Logarithmic Sobolev inequality from subgaussian marginals

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Does an absolute C exist such that each centered log-concave probability measure $\mu $ with a Lebesgue density on $R^{n}$ and each $a>0$ satisfying $sup_{|\theta |=1}\int \exp (\langle x,\theta \rangle ^{2}/a^{2})d\mu \leq 2$ obeys $Ent_\mu (f^{2})\leq Ca^{2}\int |\nabla f|^{2}d\mu $ for every compactly supported smooth f? $Ent_\mu (g)=\int g$ $logg-(\int g)\log (\int g)$. The same C must work for all $n,a,\mu $.

title: Sharp entropy lower bound for log-concave densities

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every log-concave probability density f on $R^{m}$, must its differential entropy $h(f)=-\int f$ logf satisfy $h(f)\geq m+\tfrac12 \log $ det Cov(f)? Is equality equivalent, up to almost-everywhere change, to f being the density of $M(E_{1},\dots ,E_m)+b$ with M invertible and independent standard exponential $E_i$ supported on $[0,\infty )$? No symmetry or smoothness is assumed.

title: Subpolynomial nonlinear dimension reduction in Lp

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each fixed $1<p<\infty $, $p\neq 2$, and $D>1$, does a constant $C_{p,D}$ exist such that every n-point subset of any real Lp space embeds, with freely chosen positive scale and distortion at most D, into $\ell p^d$ for $d\leq \exp (C_{p,D}(\log $ $n)^\gamma )$, where $\gamma =2-p$ for $p<2$ and $\gamma =1-2/p$ for $p>2$? Maps need not be linear, and $n\geq 2$.

title: Liftability without spectrahedrality for a hyperbolicity cone

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Is there a real homogeneous hyperbolic polynomial whose closed cone has an exact finite semidefinite lift but is not itself the positive-semidefinite locus of any affine symmetric pencil in its original variables? Auxiliary variables are allowed for the lift but forbidden in the latter representation.

title: Uniform L1 distortion of planar graph metrics

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Is there one finite C such that every finite connected planar graph with arbitrary positive real edge lengths has a map f into a real $L^{1}$ space and a scale $s>0$ satisfying $s\cdot d(x,y)\leq \Vert f(x)-f(y)\Vert _{1}\leq C\cdot s\cdot d(x,y)$ for all vertices, where d is weighted shortest-path distance?

title: Projected Lax conjecture

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every real homogeneous polynomial hyperbolic in direction $e$, is its closed cone $K(p,e)$ exactly the set of $x$ for which some $u\in\mathbb{R}^a$ makes $A_0+\sum_i x_iA_i+\sum_j u_jB_j$ positive semidefinite, for some finite $a$ and finite real symmetric matrices, without taking the closure of the projection?

title: Finite cylinder approximation of ruled sets

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every compact $D\subset\mathbb{R}^2$, every $C^1$ field $V$ near $D$, and $L,h>0$ satisfying $\operatorname{tr}DV=0$ and $-L^{-2}<\det DV\leq0$ on $D$, can $\{(s,p+sV(p)):p\in D,|s|\leq L\}$, for each $\varepsilon>0$, be covered by finitely many $\operatorname{Cyl}(T_i,g_i)=\{(s,\xi):\xi\in T_i+sg_i\}$ with compact nondegenerate square tiles $T_i$ and cost $\sum_i|T_i|/\sqrt{1+g_{i,1}^2+h^2g_{i,2}^2}\leq\int_D(1+V_1^2+h^2V_2^2)^{-1/2}+\varepsilon$? This cost is the physical perpendicular-base cost divided by $h$ under $(s,\xi_1,\xi_2)\mapsto(s,\xi_1,h\xi_2)$.

title: Single-lattice covering density of order n log n

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Does an absolute $C>0$ exist such that, for every $n\geq 2$ and convex body $K\subset R^{n}$, some full-rank lattice $\Lambda $ satisfies $K+\Lambda =R^{n}$ and $vol_n(K)/det\Lambda \leq Cn$ log n? No symmetry, smoothness or normalization of K is assumed.

title: Gromov width of symmetric polar products

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every $n\geq2$ and origin-symmetric convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, with $K^\circ=\{y:\langle x,y\rangle\leq1\text{ for all }x\in K\}$, does $\operatorname{int}(K\times K^\circ)\subset\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ with the standard symplectic structure have Gromov width $4$; equivalently, does every open standard ball of capacity $c<4$ admit a smooth symplectic embedding into it, and none of capacity $c>4$?

title: Worst-case symmetric translative covering density

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Are there constants $c>0$ and $n_{0}$ such that, for every $n\geq n_{0}$, some origin-symmetric convex body $K_n\subset R^{n}$ has translative covering density greater than c n log n? Translative covering density is the infimum of the asymptotic covering density over arbitrary coverings by translates of $K_n$, with multiplicities counted.

title: Triangular minimum of planar Coulomb renormalized energy

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement:
Let $\Lambda\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be locally finite, with no multiplicities and bounded centered-disk point density. Let $E$ be locally integrable, with $\operatorname{div}E=2\pi(\sum_{p\in\Lambda}\delta_p-1)$ and $\operatorname{curl}E=0$ in the distributional sense. For each $R$, choose a smooth cutoff $\chi_R$ supported on $[-R,R]^2$, equal to one on $[-R+1,R-1]^2$, taking values between zero and one, and with gradients uniformly bounded over $R$. Define
\[W(E)=\limsup_{R\to\infty}\frac{1}{4R^2}\lim_{\eta\downarrow0}\left[\frac12\int_{\mathbb R^2\setminus\bigcup_{p\in\Lambda}B(p,\eta)}\chi_R|E|^2+\pi\log\eta\sum_{p\in\Lambda}\chi_R(p)\right].\]
Must $W(E)$ be at least the finite value for the covolume-one triangular periodic field, for every such field and every such cutoff family?

title: Affine Bernstein assertion for entire graphs in dimension ten

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Must every smooth function $u:R^{10}\to R$ with everywhere positive-definite Hessian, satisfying $\Sigma _ij$ $U^ij$ $\partial _ij(det$ $D^{2}u)^{-11/12}=0$ and $U=det(D^{2}u)(D^{2}u)^{-1}$, be a quadratic polynomial plus an affine term?

title: Affine Bernstein assertion in dimensions three through nine

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For $3\leq n\leq 9$, let u be smooth on a nonempty open convex $\Omega \subset R^{n}$ with $D^{2}u$ positive definite and $\Sigma _ij$ $U^ij$ $\partial _ij(det$ $D^{2}u)^(-(n+1)/(n+2))=0$, $U=det(D^{2}u)(D^{2}u)^{-1}$. If the graph metric $\delta _ij+u_i$ $u_j$ is complete, must $\Omega =R^{n}$ and $u(x)=\tfrac12 x^{T}Ax+b\cdot x+c$ with A positive definite?

title: Analytic path selection at several exponential ends

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Consider finitely many real holomorphic functions of real lengths $L_{1},\dots ,L_m$ and parameters z near a finite real $z_{0}$. Require bounded holomorphic extension to products Re $L>A$, |Im $L|<c(Re$ $L)^{2}$; recursively discrete nonnegative exponential-power expansions in each length with finite polynomial factors, strictly better exponential remainders at every cutoff, common tail holomorphy domains for all coefficients, and locally finite grouped weights on positive linear-rate specializations. If a finite Boolean combination of sign/equality conditions holds on a sequence with every $L_i\to \infty $ and $z\to z_{0}$, must it hold eventually on one real analytic path with the same limits and eventually monotone or constant coordinates? Additional finite lists may also be required monotone and prescribed finite function limits retained.

title: Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every closed connected symplectic manifold M and every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism $\varphi $ with nondegenerate fixed points, must $\#Fix(\varphi )$ be at least the minimum number of critical points of a Morse function on M? The minimum is restricted to Morse functions, whereas the existing Crit record is not.

title: Stable Morse lower bound for Hamiltonian fixed points

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every closed connected symplectic manifold M and every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism $\varphi $ with all fixed points nondegenerate, must $\#Fix(\varphi )\geq SM(M)$? Here SM(M) is the minimum number of critical points of Morse functions on $M×R^k$ that agree outside a compact set with a nondegenerate quadratic form in the $R^k$ variables, minimized over $k\geq 0$.

title: Bounded scalar curvature extends closed four-dimensional Ricci flow

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Let g(t), $0\leq t<T<\infty $, be a smooth Ricci flow from a smooth metric on a closed connected smooth four-manifold. If $sup_{M×[0,T})|Scal_g(t)|$ is finite, must g(t) extend as a smooth Ricci flow on the same manifold to an interval $[0,T+\varepsilon )$ for some $\varepsilon >0$?

title: Smooth isometric immersion of closed surfaces into four-space

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each compact smooth surface M without boundary and each smooth Riemannian metric g on M, is there a smooth map $F:M\to R^{4}$ with injective differential at every point and $F*\delta =g$? The map may have self-intersections, and M may be nonorientable.

title: Uniform bi-Hölder transport under weak MTW

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Fix a compact connected smooth boundaryless Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two satisfying weak MTW for half-squared distance, and positive numbers $\lambda \leq \Lambda $. Do constants $\alpha >0$ and $C<\infty $ depending only on that metric and $\lambda ,\Lambda $ guarantee that for every pair of probability densities between $\lambda $ and $\Lambda $ almost everywhere, the optimal map has a homeomorphic representative and it and its inverse are globally $\alpha$-Hölder with constant C?

title: Conditional L² Einstein gap for nonnegative curvature

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Assume that every connected smooth closed Riemannian four-manifold (N,h) with $Ric_h=3h$ and $sec_h\geq 0$ has universal Riemannian cover isometric to round $S^{4}$ of curvature 1, Fubini–Study $CP^{2}$ with $Ric=3g$, or $S^{2}(1/\surd 3)×S^{2}(1/\surd 3)$. Does there then exist $\varepsilon >0$ such that every simply connected closed smooth Riemannian four-manifold (M,g) with $sec_g\geq 0$ and $\int |Ric_g-(Scal_g/4)g|^{2}dvol_g<\varepsilon $ is diffeomorphic to $S^{4}$, $CP^{2}$ or $S^{2}×S^{2}$, without a prescribed orientation?

title: Isoperimetric profile of the cubic flat three-torus

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement:
On $\mathbb R^3/\mathbb Z^3$, let $V\in(0,1)$ be the prescribed volume and put $v=\min(V,1-V)$. Is the least perimeter
\[\min\bigl\{(36\pi)^{1/3}v^{2/3},\;2\sqrt{\pi v},\;2\bigr\}?\]
Are all minimizers, modulo isometry and null sets, balls for $v\leq4\pi/81$, round tubes along shortest geodesics for $4\pi/81\leq v\leq1/\pi$, coordinate slabs for $v\geq1/\pi$, and their complements for $V>1/2$, with exactly both adjacent types at transition volumes?

title: Unique multiplicity-one tangents at first surface-flow singularities

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For a smooth compact connected embedded surface without boundary in $R^{3}$, must the full family of parabolic rescalings at every singular point of the first maximal smooth mean-curvature-flow time converge, in the original coordinates and locally smoothly with multiplicity one at all negative times, to one smooth properly embedded self-shrinker flow?

title: Gigli distributional sectional-curvature characterization

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For a complete separable metric space (X,d), integer $n\geq 2$ and $\kappa \in R$, is being an n-dimensional Alexandrov space of curvature $\geq \kappa $ equivalent to full-support $RCD((n-1)\kappa ,n)$ with measure $H^{n}_d$ and distributional curvature satisfying $R(A,B,B,A)(f)\geq \kappa \int f(|A|^{2}|B|^{2}-\langle A,B\rangle ^{2})dH^{n}$ for every nonnegative test function f and test vector fields A,B? Use the unreduced RCD and test classes in the cited theorem.

title: Exact ball-packing criterion in symplectic dimensions at least six

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For $n\geq 3$ and positive capacities $R,R_{1},\dots ,R_k$, do neighborhood-defined symplectic embeddings of the disjoint closed standard 2n-balls of capacities $R_i$ into the interior of the standard ball of capacity R exist exactly when $\Sigma _i$ $R_i^{n}<R^{n}$ and $R_i+R_j<R$ for every distinct pair i,j? Capacity is $\pi $ times squared Euclidean radius.

title: Deforming hypersymplectic triples to hyperkähler triples

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Let X be a closed oriented connected smooth four-manifold and let $\omega _{1},\omega _{2},\omega _{3}$ be closed smooth real two-forms such that every nonzero real linear combination is symplectic and $\int _X$ $\omega _i\wedge \omega _j=\delta _ij$. Must the triple admit a smooth path of such positive triples with each de Rham class fixed, ending at a triple of parallel self-dual forms for a hyperkähler metric?

title: Euclidean comparison for integer-growth harmonic dimensions

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every complete smooth nonnegative-Ricci n-manifold and integer $k\geq 0$, must the real vector space of harmonic functions bounded in absolute value by some function-dependent constant times (1+distance from a fixed $point)^k$ have dimension at most that space on Euclidean $R^{n}$?

title: Harmonic dimension comparison in dimension three

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every complete smooth metric g on $R^{3}$ with $Ric_g\geq 0$ and each integer $k\geq 0$, must the space of real harmonic functions of growth at most degree k have dimension $\leq (k+1)^{2}$, the Euclidean value? Each harmonic function may have its own growth constant.

title: Uniformization with positive bisectional curvature

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Is every connected noncompact complex n-manifold, $n\geq 1$, carrying a complete smooth Kähler metric with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature biholomorphic to $C^{n}$?

title: Metric classification of Blaschke manifolds

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: If a connected closed smooth Riemannian manifold of positive dimension has injectivity radius equal to diameter, must some positive scaling of its metric be isometric to a standard round sphere, real/complex/quaternionic projective space, or Cayley plane?

title: Bounded coordinates for negatively pinched Kähler manifolds

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Must a contractible complex manifold with a complete smooth Kähler metric satisfying $-B\leq sec\leq -A<0$ for finite positive $A\leq B$ admit a bounded holomorphic map into $C^{n}$ with everywhere nonzero complex Jacobian, where n is its complex dimension?

title: Bi-Lipschitz coordinates at regular RCD points

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each $n\geq 2$, is there L(n) such that any point p of a noncollapsed RCD(K,n) space $(X,d,H^{n}_d)$, whose every pointed tangent is Euclidean $R^{n}$, has an ambient-open neighborhood bi-Lipschitz homeomorphic with constant L(n) to an open Euclidean set? The chart uses the restricted ambient metric, and L(n) is independent of K and the space.

title: Nonnegative Einstein curvature classification in dimension four

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: If a connected closed smooth Riemannian four-manifold has $Ric=3g$ and sectional curvature $\geq 0$, is its universal Riemannian cover isometric to the round $S^{4}$ of curvature 1, the Fubini–Study $CP^{2}$ normalized to $Ric=3g$, or $S^{2}(1/\surd 3)×S^{2}(1/\surd 3)$?

title: Bounded holomorphic functions under one-sided negative curvature

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Must a complex domain diffeomorphic to $R^{2m}$, $m\geq 2$, carrying a complete smooth Kähler metric with $sec\leq -1$ possess a nonconstant bounded holomorphic function? No finite lower bound on sectional curvature is imposed.

title: Positive Einstein metric classification in dimension four

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: Must every connected closed smooth Einstein four-manifold with strictly positive sectional curvature be isometric, after a positive metric scaling, to standard $S^{4}$, $CP^{2}$ with its Fubini–Study metric, or round $RP^{4}$? Nonorientable manifolds are included.

title: Euclidean sharp filling bounds in proper CAT(0) spaces

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every proper CAT(0) space X and integer $n\geq 2$, does every compactly supported Ambrosio–Kirchheim integral n-current T with $\partial T=0$ bound a compactly supported integral (n+1)-current S satisfying $M(S)\leq [(n+1)^((n+1)/n)\omega _{n+1}^{1/n}]^{-1}$ $M(T)^((n+1)/n)$, where $\omega _j$ is unit Euclidean j-ball volume?

title: Weak Hessian bounds along every RCD geodesic

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: In a complete separable full-support RCD(K,N) metric measure space with finite $N>1$ and measure finite on bounded sets, let F be bounded and globally Lipschitz and G bounded and continuous. If Hess $F\leq G\cdot g$ weakly against compact test gradients and nonnegative compactly supported Lipschitz weights, does each constant-speed minimizing geodesic $\gamma :[0,1]\to X$ satisfy $(F\circ \gamma )\prime\prime \leq d(\gamma (0),\gamma (1))^{2}G\circ \gamma $ in distributions?

title: Infinitely many prime geodesic images on spheres

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every $n\geq 2$ and every smooth Riemannian metric on the standard smooth sphere $S^{n}$, must there be infinitely many geometrically distinct prime closed geodesics? Geometric distinctness means different image sets; simplicity is not required.

title: Integral scalar-curvature control of simplicial volume

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every integer $n\geq 3$, is there a positive constant a(n) such that every closed connected oriented smooth n-manifold M and every smooth metric g satisfy $a(n)\Vert M\Vert \leq \int _M$ $max(0,-Scal_g)^{n/2}$ $dvol_g$, with $\Vert M\Vert $ the real simplicial volume?

title: Least volume of nongeodesic minimal hypersurfaces in spheres

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each integer $m\geq 2$, must a closed connected smooth m-manifold minimally immersed in the unit $S^{m+1}$, with image not totally geodesic, have induced volume at least the least volume among the Clifford hypersurfaces $S^p(\surd (p/m))×S^{m-p}(\surd ((m-p)/m))$, $1\leq p<m$?

title: Spectral scalar-curvature control of codimension-two width

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each $n\geq 4$, does a constant C(n) exist such that every connected complete smooth boundaryless Riemannian n-manifold satisfying $\int (4|\nabla \varphi |^{2}+Scal\cdot \varphi ^{2})\geq \int \varphi ^{2}$ for every real compactly supported smooth $\varphi $ admits a continuous map into a simplicial complex of dimension $\leq n-2$, each fiber having metric diameter $\leq C(n)$?

title: Spectral scalar-curvature control of width in dimension three

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: If a connected complete smooth three-manifold without boundary satisfies $\int (4|\nabla \varphi |^{2}+Scal\cdot \varphi ^{2})\geq \lambda \int \varphi ^{2}$ for some $\lambda >0$ and every compactly supported real smooth $\varphi $, must there be a continuous map to a one-dimensional simplicial complex whose every fiber has diameter at most $500/\surd \lambda $?

title: Codimension-one singular bound for stationary integral varifolds

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For all positive m,n and every stationary integral m-varifold V in an open subset of $R^{m+n}$, is $dim_H$ $Sing(V)\leq m-1$? Sing(V) excludes points with a neighborhood on which V is a constant positive integer multiple of a smooth embedded minimal m-submanifold.

title: Positive scalar curvature and codimension-two width

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For every $n\geq 4$, is the codimension-two Urysohn width of all connected complete smooth boundaryless n-manifolds with $Scal\geq 1$ bounded by one constant depending on n only? Urysohn width means the infimum of maximal fiber diameter over continuous maps to simplicial complexes of dimension $\leq n-2$.

title: Sharp nodal upper bound on smooth surfaces

category.name: geometry
category.description: Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometry, geometric structures.

statement: For each connected closed smooth Riemannian surface (M,g), does one finite C(M,g) bound $H^{1}_g({u=0})\leq C(M,g)\surd \lambda $ for every nonzero real smooth eigenfunction $-\Delta _g$ $u=\lambda u$ with $\lambda >0$?

title: Weak mixing of every triangular billiard with an irrational angle

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every Euclidean triangle having at least one angle whose ratio to pi is irrational, is its billiard flow weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure, after deleting trajectories that hit a vertex?

title: Pointwise convergence of all consecutive-power multiple averages under mixing

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every invertible mixing transformation T preserving a probability measure, every integer $m>=2$ and bounded measurable $f_1,...,f_m$, do $(1/N)sum_{n=1}^N$ $product_{j=1}^m$ $f_j(T^{jn}x)$ converge for almost every x to $product_j$ integral $f_j$?

title: Pointwise triple ergodic averages with distinct integer slopes under mixing

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation T, every three pairwise distinct nonzero integers a,b,c, and bounded measurable f,g,h, do $(1/N)sum_{n=1}^N$ $f(T^{an}x)g(T^{bn}x)h(T^{cn}x)$ converge almost everywhere to (integral f)(integral g)(integral h), including mixed-sign slopes?

title: Pointwise convergence of fourfold ergodic averages under mixing

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation T and bounded measurable $f_1,f_2,f_3,f_4$, do $(1/N)sum_{n=1}^N$ $f_1(T^n$ $x)f_2(T^{2n}x)f_3(T^{3n}x)f_4(T^{4n}x)$ converge almost everywhere to the product of the four integrals?

title: Pointwise convergence of consecutive triple ergodic averages under mixing

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation T and bounded measurable f,g,h, do $(1/N)sum_{n=1}^N$ $f(T^n$ $x)g(T^{2n}x)h(T^{3n}x)$ converge almost everywhere to (integral f)(integral g)(integral h)?

title: Dimension of a real self-similar attractor without exact overlaps

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For a finite nonempty real similarity family $\phi _i(x)=r_i$ $x+t_i$ with $0<|r_i|<1$, assume distinct nonempty words define distinct composed maps. If K is its compact attractor and $s>=0$ solves $sum_i$ $|r_i|^s=1$, must $dim_H$ $K=min(1,s)$, without any effective separation or algebraicity assumption?

title: Singularity of Bernoulli convolutions at quartic Salem reciprocals

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every quartic Salem algebraic integer beta in (1,2), is the Bernoulli convolution given by the distribution of $sum_{n>=0}$ $\epsilon _n$ $\beta ^{-n}$, with independent equiprobable $\epsilon _n$ in \{-1,1\}, singular with respect to Lebesgue measure?

title: Exact maximal limit-cycle count for quintic classical Lienard systems

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: Over all real polynomials F of degree at most five, is the maximum number of isolated periodic orbits of $x-prime=y-F(x)$, $y-prime=-x$ exactly two, without an oddness, damping-sign or small-amplitude restriction?

title: Entropy-rate dimension formula for all real self-similar measures

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For a finite nonempty indexed family $\phi _i(x)=r_i$ $x+t_i$ with real $t_i$, $0<|r_i|<1$ and strictly positive weights $p_i$ summing to one, let $\mu =sum_i$ $p_i(\phi _i)_*\mu $. Let $G_n$ be the random complete affine map $\phi _I1$ composed with ... composed with $\phi _In$ for independent letters with law p, $h_RW=lim_n$ $H(G_n)/n$ and $chi=-sum_i$ $p_i$ $\log |r_i|$, using the same logarithmic base. Is the lower Hausdorff dimension of mu always $min(1,h_RW/chi)$, allowing signed unequal ratios and arbitrary exact overlaps?

title: Ellipse rigidity from a continuous physical collar of smooth caustics

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: Let a bounded planar billiard table have a C-infinity strictly convex boundary with everywhere positive curvature. If a whole inner boundary collar is continuously foliated by individually C-infinity strictly convex closed caustics, with no differentiability of the transverse foliation assumed, must the boundary be an ellipse?

title: Uniform finiteness of planar polynomial limit cycles

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: For every integer $d>=1$, does there exist a finite B(d) such that every real planar polynomial vector field $x-prime=P(x,y)$, $y-prime=Q(x,y)$, with max(deg P,deg $Q)<=d$, has at most B(d) geometrically distinct isolated periodic orbits throughout the plane?

title: Zero-entropy probability system with no smooth positive-volume model

category.name: dynamical_systems
category.description: Problems about long-term behavior of deterministic systems, Hamiltonian dynamics, and periodic orbits.

statement: Does there exist an invertible ergodic measure-preserving transformation on a standard nonatomic probability space, with zero Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy, which is not measure-theoretically isomorphic to any C-infinity diffeomorphism preserving a strictly positive smooth probability density on any finite-dimensional compact smooth manifold, including nonorientable manifolds and manifolds with boundary?

title: Asymptotic midpoint renormability versus AUC

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Must every infinite-dimensional real Banach space that admits an asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm also admit an equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm? Positivity of the midpoint modulus is in the finite-codimensional averaged two-sided convention; AUC uses the corresponding one-sided convention.

title: Linear rigidity of bi-Lipschitz equivalent separable Banach spaces

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If two separable real Banach spaces are joined by a bi-Lipschitz bijection, must they be linearly isomorphic?

title: Linear c0 detection from bi-Lipschitz absorption

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If a separable real Banach space Z is bi-Lipschitz equivalent to Z direct-sum-infinity c0, must Z contain a closed linear subspace isomorphic to c0?

title: The cotype-cotype conjecture with the approximation property

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every nonzero real Banach space X with the ordinary approximation property, is X K-convex if and only if both X and its continuous dual have finite cotype, allowing different finite exponents for the two spaces?

title: Metric Markov cotype two of ell1

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Does the real Banach space ell1 have finite metric Markov cotype two, uniformly over all finite stationary reversible Markov chains and all positive integer times?

title: Superreflexivity from nontrivial Markov type

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.
