statement: Must every real Banach space with Markov type p for some $p>1$ be superreflexive, equivalently admit an equivalent uniformly convex norm?

title: Uniform duality for convex-body covering entropy

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Are there constants $a,b\geq1$, independent of dimension and of the convex bodies $K,L$ symmetric about zero, such that $\log N(K,L)\leq b\log N(L^\circ,a^{-1}K^\circ)$ always holds, where $N(K,L)$ is the least number of translates of $L$ covering $K$ and $K^\circ=\{y:\sup_{x\in K}x\cdot y\leq1\}$ is the polar, defined similarly for $L$?

title: Reflexive asymptotic midpoint renormability versus AUC

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Must every infinite-dimensional real reflexive Banach space that admits an asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm also admit an equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm? Here midpoint uniform convexity means a positive finite-codimensional averaged two-sided modulus at every positive radius, whereas AUC requires the corresponding one-sided modulus positive.

title: Nonexpansive fixed points in reflexive Banach spaces

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every real reflexive Banach space X, every nonempty norm-closed bounded convex C subset X, and every nonexpansive map $F:C->C$, must F have a fixed point?

title: The separable quotient assertion under CH

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Assuming the Continuum Hypothesis, must every infinite-dimensional real or complex Banach space admit a quotient by a closed linear subspace that is infinite-dimensional and separable?

title: The separable quotient assertion for a real-valued-measurable continuum

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Assuming that the cardinality of the continuum is real-valued measurable, must every infinite-dimensional real or complex Banach space admit an infinite-dimensional separable quotient by a closed linear subspace?

title: Tingley extension for real Banach spaces

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For any nonzero real Banach spaces X and Y, must every surjective isometry from the unit sphere of X onto the unit sphere of Y extend to a unique surjective real-linear isometry $X->Y$?

title: Bounded approximation in uniformly discrete Lipschitz-free spaces

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If a pointed metric space M is uniformly discrete and its real Lipschitz-free Banach space has the approximation property, must that free space have the bounded approximation property for some finite constant?

title: All-pairs diamond distortion in tree-segment Banach spaces

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Let J be the real Banach-space completion of finite real arrays on the disjoint countably branching finite-height forest for the supremum $\ell _2$ norm of sums over pairwise disjoint tree segments, and $X=J*$. Let $B_infinity$ be the closed coordinate span in the dual of the analogous infinite-tree completion. Let $D_k$ be the depth-k countably branching normalized diamond, each edge replaced by countably many two-edge paths of the same total length. For every $k>=0$, every positive scale s, and every metric embedding into either X or $B_infinity$ satisfying s $d_k(u,v)<=norm(f(u)-f(v))<=D$ s $d_k(u,v)$ for all pairs, must $D^2>=1+k/4$?

title: Hyperbolicity of one-relator groups without Baumslag–Solitar subgroups

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For finite X and any $r\in F(X)$, is $\langle X|r\rangle $ word-hyperbolic whenever it contains no subgroup isomorphic to BS(m,n) for any nonzero integers m,n?

title: Decidable word problem and embedding in finitely presented simple groups

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: Is it true that a finitely generated group has a decidable word problem exactly when it admits an injective homomorphism into a finitely presented simple group?

title: Simple overgroups of type F infinity for decidable word problems

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: Does every finitely generated group with decidable word problem embed in a nontrivial simple group H admitting a classifying CW complex with finitely many cells in each dimension?

title: Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic ascending free-group mapping tori

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For a finitely generated free group F and injective endomorphism $\varphi :F\to F$, if the ascending HNN extension $\langle F,t|t^{-1}ft=\varphi (f)$, $f\in F\rangle $ is word-hyperbolic, must it be virtually compact special?

title: Geometric CAT(0) actions for word-hyperbolic groups

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: Does every word-hyperbolic group admit a proper cocompact isometric action on a nonempty proper complete CAT(0) space?

title: Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For any finite X and relator $r\in F(X)$, if $G=\langle X|r\rangle $ is word-hyperbolic, does some finite-index subgroup of G occur as the fundamental group of a finite compact special cube complex?

title: An infinite residually finite group with finite presentation and 2-power torsion

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: Does an infinite group G exist with an ordinary finite presentation, residual finiteness and the property that every element has finite order equal to a power of2? No common exponent is prescribed.

title: A nontrivial group free-product Z cannot be normally generated by one element

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For every nontrivial group A and every $w\in A*Z$, is $(A*Z)/\langle \langle w\rangle \rangle $ nontrivial?

title: Coefficient-preserving solutions of nonsingular group-equation systems

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For every group G and finite list $w_{1},\dots ,w_m\in G*F_n,1\leq m\leq n$, whose exponent-sum matrix has row rank m over Q, is $G\to (G*F_n)/\langle \langle w_{1},\dots ,w_m\rangle \rangle $ injective; equivalently, are the equations simultaneously soluble in an overgroup containing G?

title: Recognizing virtually polycyclic groups from quasi-isometry

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: If a finitely generated group H is quasi-isometric to a finitely generated virtually polycyclic group P, must H itself be virtually polycyclic?

title: Strong Ulam stability characterizes amenability

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For a countable discrete group G, does amenability follow from this property: for every $\varepsilon >0$ there exists $\delta >0$ such that, on every complex Hilbert space H, each normalized map $\mu :G\to U(H)$ with $sup_{g,h}\Vert \mu (gh)-\mu (g)\mu (h)\Vert \leq \delta $ is within $\varepsilon $ uniformly on G of a genuine unitary representation on that same H?

title: Coefficient injectivity for unimodular one-variable equations

category.name: group_theory
category.description: Problems about groups, group actions, representations, and related algebraic structures.

statement: For every group A and word $w\in A*\langle t\rangle $ with exponent sum1 $or-1$ in t, is the canonical homomorphism $A\to (A*\langle t\rangle )/\langle \langle w\rangle \rangle $ injective?

title: Downward categoricity transfer to the Hanf threshold under CH

category.name: logic
category.description: Problems in mathematical logic, model theory, proof theory, and finite model theory.

statement: Assume CH. If an abstract elementary class K in a countable finitary relational language has $LS(K)=\aleph _{0}$ and is categorical in a cardinal above $H(K)=beth_{\omega _{2}}$, must it be categorical in H(K), without amalgamation, tameness or joint-embedding assumptions?

title: Capturing polynomial time with choiceless computation and counting

category.name: logic
category.description: Problems in mathematical logic, model theory, proof theory, and finite model theory.

statement: Is every isomorphism-invariant Boolean query that is decidable in deterministic polynomial time on all finite structures definable in choiceless polynomial time with counting, allowing hereditarily finite sets of arbitrary finite rank and polynomial bounds on computation stages and intermediate objects?

title: Unique natural-number witnesses for every enumerable set

category.name: logic
category.description: Problems in mathematical logic, model theory, proof theory, and finite model theory.

statement: For every $n\geq 1$ and recursively enumerable $S\subset N^{n}$, do there exist $m\geq 1$ and $P\in Z[A_{1},\dots ,A_{n},W_{1},\dots ,W_m]$ such that each $a\in S$ has exactly one tuple $w\in N^m$ with $P(a,w)=0$ and each $a\notin S$ has none?

title: Global weak normalization implies strong normalization in pure type systems

category.name: logic
category.description: Problems in mathematical logic, model theory, proof theory, and finite model theory.

statement: For every pure type system with arbitrary sorts, axioms and rules, if every legal expression in every valid context has some terminating $\beta$-reduction sequence, must every $\beta$-reduction sequence of each such expression terminate? Reduction includes type annotations and the specification need not be functional.

title: Strict expressive gain from witnessed symmetric choice

category.name: logic
category.description: Problems in mathematical logic, model theory, proof theory, and finite model theory.

statement: Does adding witnessed symmetric choice to choiceless polynomial time with counting strictly increase the Boolean queries definable on all finite structures, even when one total sentence uses only one witnessed-choice occurrence?

title: The numerical spacetime enclosing-area inequality in every dimension

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every $n\geq 3$, consider smooth complete one-ended asymptotically Euclidean initial-data exteriors with integrable constraint densities, DEC, finite ADM limits, weakly future-trapped compact boundary, $g-\delta =O_6(r^{-q})$, $K=O_5(r^{-1-q})$, $(n-2)/2<q<n-2$, $E>|P|$ and positive full minimum enclosing area $A_min$. Is $\operatorname{sqrt}(E^2-|P|^2)\geq (1/2)(A_min/\omega _{n-1})^((n-2)/(n-1))$?

title: Single-letter classical capacity of generalized amplitude damping

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every generalized amplitude-damping qubit channel $A_{\gamma ,\nu }$, $\gamma ,\nu \in [0,1]$, is its n-copy Holevo information exactly n times its one-copy value for every $n\geq 1$? Require that the one-copy optimizer is a phase-opposite equiprobable pair $\operatorname{sqrt}(1-p)|0>\pm \operatorname{sqrt}(p)|1>$, so its optimized output-entropy difference gives the unassisted classical capacity.

title: Unbounded positive point spectrum of relative SU(2) BFSS

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Does the gauge-invariant relative SU(2) BFSS Hamiltonian have an orthonormal sequence of eigenvectors in its operator domain with strictly positive eigenvalues tending to infinity?

title: Exactly one threshold bound state in every relative SU(N) BFSS model

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every integer $N\geq 2$, does the gauge-invariant relative SU(N) BFSS Hamiltonian, with its source-defined self-adjoint domain and fermion grading, have a one-dimensional zero-energy kernel consisting of Spin(9)-invariant even states?

title: QMA hardness of continuum electronic energy with binary nuclear charges

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Is the ground-energy promise problem for the full antisymmetric continuum electronic Coulomb Hamiltonian QMA-hard under deterministic classical polynomial-time many-one reductions when nuclear charges are positive binary integers, positions and thresholds are rational, electron count is unary, and the threshold gap is at least inverse input length? Ask for reductions with gap at least one, without auxiliary effective interactions.

title: The first lattice correction to quantum Bloch magnetization

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every fixed positive half-integer spin S in the nearest-neighbor $Z^3$ quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet, does (beta $S)^{5/2}[S-m_S(\beta )-n_S^sw(\beta )]\to 0$ as beta$\to$infinity, where $n_S^sw$ is the full lattice spin-wave Bose occupation integral?

title: Polynomial quantum synthesis of any unitary using a suitable Boolean oracle

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Is there one classically polynomial-time uniform family $A_n$ of quantum oracle circuits over H,T,T-dagger,CNOT, with polynomially many qubits, gates, calls and oracle input bits, such that for every n-qubit unitary U some Boolean oracle f makes its output channel within diamond distance 1/2 of conjugation by U? The oracle may depend on U but the circuit template may only depend on n.

title: A gap in the open spin-one chain with fixed same-sign boundary fields

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For spin-one $H_L=sum_{j=-L}^{L-1}$ $S_j\cdot S_{j+1}-(3/5)(S_{-L}^z+S_L^z)$, is the difference between its two lowest eigenvalues, counted with multiplicity, greater than log(10)/392 for every integer $L\geq 960$?

title: A conditional charged Penrose bound in spatial dimension at least four

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Assuming the stated neutral spacetime Penrose input in every spatial dimension $n\geq 4$, do the smooth one-ended purely electric charged DEC exteriors of the manuscript satisfy $m\geq |Q|$ and $X_A\leq m+\operatorname{sqrt}(m^2-Q^2)$, with $X_A=(A_min/\omega _{n-1})^((n-2)/(n-1))$ and the manuscript-normalized total electric charge Q? Include strict positivity and timelikeness of ADM mass and the large-area branch $m\geq (X_A+Q^2/X_A)/2$ for $X_A>|Q|$.

title: A charged enclosing-area bound for weakly asymptotically Euclidean exteriors

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For smooth complete one-ended three-dimensional initial-data exteriors with compact boundary, $g-\delta =O_2(r^{-q})$ and $K=O_1(r^{-1-q})$ for $q>1/2$, electric and magnetic fields $O_1(r^{-2})$, integrable constraint densities, finite ADM and charge limits, the charged matter dominant-energy condition, and source-free exterior electric and magnetic fields, does a weakly trapped condition of either fixed sign on each boundary component imply positive ADM rest mass m, $m\geq Q$ and $r_A\leq m+\operatorname{sqrt}(m^2-Q^2)$? Here Q is the norm of total electric and magnetic charges and $r_A=\operatorname{sqrt}(A_min/(4\pi ))$, with $A_min$ the full enclosing-cut infimum. For connected nondegenerate outermost outer-minimizing horizons, ask for the stated original-data Reissner–Nordström equality rigidity.

title: A Bondi enclosing-area inequality for CKS hyperboloidal ends

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For the manuscript smooth three-dimensional CKS hyperboloidal exterior class with DEC, future-timelike Bondi energy-momentum, weakly future-trapped possibly disconnected boundary and positive full minimum enclosing area, is $\operatorname{sqrt}(E_B^2-|P_B|^2)\geq \operatorname{sqrt}(A_min/(16\pi ))$? Require sharpness from horizon-regular Schwarzschild hyperboloidal exteriors.

title: Local noninteracting ensemble representation of Coulomb ground densities

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Must every normalizable full Coulomb electronic ground-state density be the density of some ground-state ensemble of a local noninteracting Kohn–Sham Hamiltonian with potential in the admissible source class V? It suffices to test three electrons with two identical finite-charge nuclei and the fixed spin sector $S_z=1/2$.

title: An exponential threshold-repetition bound for arbitrary finite entangled games

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every finite two-player one-round Boolean-acceptance game G with finite-dimensional entangled value $v<1$, is there universal $\kappa _0>0$ such that any finite-dimensional joint k-repetition strategy wins at least ceil((v+delta)k) coordinates with probability at most $\exp (-\kappa _0$ $\delta ^5$ k/(1+log d)), for $0<\delta <1-v$ and d the source answer-alphabet parameter? Correlated question distributions are allowed.

title: The entropy photon-number inequality for arbitrary finite-mode inputs

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For independent finite-energy n-mode bosonic inputs $\rho _A$ and $\rho _B$, any finite $n\geq 1$ and $0\leq \eta \leq 1$, let $\rho _C$ be the n output modes of passive beam-splitter mixing $c_j=\operatorname{sqrt}(\eta )a_j+\operatorname{sqrt}(1-\eta )b_j$. Is $g^{-1}(S(\rho _C)/n)\geq \eta $ $g^{-1}(S(\rho _A)/n)+(1-\eta )g^{-1}(S(\rho _B)/n)$, where $g(x)=(x+1)\log (x+1)-x$ log x? Internal entanglement between modes within either input is permitted.

title: Exact quantum factoring over one fixed finite gate set

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Is there a polynomial-time uniform quantum circuit family that outputs the complete prime factorization of every integer $N\geq 2$ with probability one, using a polynomial number of gates and qubits in log N and a single fixed finite gate set containing NOT, CNOT, Toffoli, Hadamard, diag(1,i), their inverses and singly controlled versions?

title: The exact Bloch coefficient for three-dimensional finite-range quantum ferromagnets

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every positive half-integer spin S and each admissible nonnegative finite-range translation-invariant coupling on $Z^3$ with positive spin-stiffness matrix $D_{S,J}$, does $\beta ^{3/2}(S-m_{S,J}(\beta ))$ tend as beta$\to$infinity to $\zeta (3/2)/(8\pi ^{3/2}\operatorname{sqrt}(det$ $D_{S,J}))$?

title: The universal quantum-depletion constant for fixed bounded repulsions

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every fixed bounded nonzero nonnegative radial finite-range pair potential v in $R^3$ with scattering length $a_v$, do all periodic-cube ground states satisfy $(1-B_\Gamma )/\operatorname{sqrt}(\rho $ $a_v^3)\to 8/(3\operatorname{sqrt}(\pi ))$ in the thermodynamic-then-dilute limit, uniformly over the ground-state space?

title: Polynomial-bond PEPS approximation of every gapped square-grid ground vector

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Fix site dimension $q\geq 2$ and bounds $J,Delta>0$. For every L-by-L square-grid Hamiltonian with site and nearest-neighbor terms of norm at most J, a unique normalized ground vector and global spectral gap at least Delta, does there exist a PEPS of maximum bond dimension at most C $L^c$ whose normalized vector is within $L^{-1}$, up to global phase, of that ground vector, with C,c depending only on q,J,Delta?

title: Thomas–Fermi asymptotics for growing atomic ionization number

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For integer $Z>m\geq 1$, define $I_m(Z)=E(Z-m,Z)-E(Z,Z)$ for full nonrelativistic Coulomb atoms with two spin states. Does $I_m(Z)/m^{7/3}$ approach the positive Thomas–Fermi constant $a_TF$ whenever m$\to$infinity and Z/m$\to$infinity? Require the same constant for the iterated m$\to$infinity limits of fixed-m Z-limsup and Z-liminf, without asserting any fixed-m convergence.

title: The Bogoliubov momentum law for the dilute hard-sphere ground state

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For fixed hard-sphere radius $a>0$, do all pure or mixed bosonic ground states in periodic cubes have a common dilute-limit nonzero-momentum occupation law: after the thermodynamic limit at fixed rho and then rho $a^3\to 0$, the measure (N sqrt(rho $a^3))^{-1}sum_{k\neq 0}n_\Gamma (k)\delta _(k/\operatorname{sqrt}(8\pi $ rho a)) converges against every bounded continuous real test to the source Bogoliubov measure? Require uniformity over the whole ground-state space.

title: Condensation in every dilute hard-sphere ground state

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Are there absolute $\epsilon _0,c_0>0$ such that for every $a,\rho >0$ with rho $a^3<\epsilon _0$, every thermodynamic sequence N,L$\to$infinity with $N/L^3\to \rho $, and every normalized bosonic hard-sphere ground eigenvector, the limiting lower condensate fraction is at least $c_0$?

title: A spherical distribution of the low-temperature total quantum spin

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every positive half-integer spin S and every sufficiently large fixed finite beta, do zero-field even periodic $Z^3$ Heisenberg cubes have volume-normalized total spin whose moment generating function tends to sinh(m|t|)/(m|t|) for some $m>0$ and every $t\in R^3$? Require the averaged finite-volume spin-dot-spin sum divided by volume squared to tend to $m^2$.

title: The area, charge and angular-momentum bound with controlled electromagnetic tails

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For the smooth axisymmetric one-ended electrovacuum exterior class with connected horizon, topology, asymptotic parity and electromagnetic-tail conditions stated in the manuscript, is $m^2\geq A/(16\pi )+Q^2/2+\pi (Q^4+4J^2)/A$? When $A>4\pi $ $\operatorname{sqrt}(Q^4+4J^2)$, require equality precisely for original-data slices inducing g,K and both electromagnetic fields from a subextremal dyonic Kerr–Newman exterior, including smooth horizon extension.

title: The Kerr–Newman area bound without electromagnetic-tail controls

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Do all smooth complete maximal axisymmetric source-free electrovacuum exteriors on ${|x|\geq 1}$, with a connected outermost future MOTS minimizing area among all enclosing cuts, $g-\delta =O_4(r^{-1})$, $K=O_3(r^{-3})$, electric and magnetic fields $O_3(r^{-2})$, integrable constraint densities and finite fluxes, zero ADM linear momentum, positive ADM energy and zero total electric and magnetic charges, obey $m^2\geq A/(16\pi )+4\pi $ $J^2/A$ on $A>8\pi |J|$, with every equality datum induced by a Kerr–Newman exterior slice? Here J is the gravitational angular-momentum flux at infinity without an electromagnetic surface term; nonzero exterior fields need not have Coulomb leading terms.

title: A Laughlin gap stable under every small bounded scalar perturbation

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For the spherical fermionic $V_1$ pseudopotential at flux $Q=3(N-1)$, are there $\lambda _*,Delta_*>0$ and $N_*$ such that every real bounded measurable scalar phi with $||\phi ||_infinity\leq 1$ and every $|\lambda |\leq \lambda _*$ gives a unique ground state and spectral gap at least $Delta_*$ for $N\geq N_*$, when lambda times the projected one-body scalar potential is added?

title: A size-independent spectral gap above the spherical Laughlin line

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For the spherical $V_1$ pseudopotential $H_{N,Q}$ at flux $Q=3(N-1)$ on $wedge^N$ $U_Q$, is $H_{N,Q}\geq (1/25)(I-P_L,N)$ for every sufficiently large N, where $P_L,N$ projects onto the Laughlin vector $product_{i<j}(u_i$ $v_j-u_j$ $v_i)^3$?

title: Every extremizer of the sharp matrix Lieb–Thirring bound

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement:
Fix $m\geq1$ and $1/2<\gamma<3/2$. Let $W:\mathbb R\to M_m(\mathbb C)$ be measurable, Hermitian, and nonnegative, with $\int_{\mathbb R}\operatorname{tr}(W^{\gamma+1/2})\,dx<\infty$. Define $H=-d^2/dx^2-W$ on $L^2(\mathbb R;\mathbb C^m)$, and put
\[C_\gamma=\left(\frac{\gamma-1/2}{\gamma+1/2}\right)^{\gamma-1/2}\frac{\Gamma(\gamma+1)}{\sqrt\pi\,\Gamma(\gamma+3/2)}.\]
Does equality in $\operatorname{Tr}(H_-^\gamma)\leq C_\gamma\int_{\mathbb R}\operatorname{tr}(W^{\gamma+1/2})\,dx$ hold exactly when a constant unitary change of basis makes $W(x)$ a diagonal collection of zero channels and channels
\[(r+1)a_j^2\operatorname{sech}^2(r a_j(x-x_j)),\qquad r=(\gamma-1/2)^{-1},\quad a_j>0,\quad x_j\in\mathbb R?\]
Each nonzero scalar channel is required to have exactly one negative eigenvalue, equal to $-a_j^2$.

title: The sharp one-dimensional finite-matrix Lieb–Thirring inequality

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every finite matrix size m, every $1/2<\gamma <3/2$ and measurable nonnegative Hermitian W with integral $\operatorname{tr}(W^{\gamma +1/2})$ finite, is $\operatorname{Tr}(-d^2/dx^2-W)_-^\gamma $ bounded by $C_\gamma $ integral $\operatorname{tr}(W^{\gamma +1/2})$, where $C_\gamma =((\gamma -1/2)/(\gamma +1/2))^{\gamma -1/2}$ Gamma(gamma+1)/(sqrt(pi) Gamma(gamma+3/2)) is optimal?

title: A uniform bound on excess electrons in full Coulomb molecules

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For the full nonrelativistic Coulomb Hamiltonian with two electron spin states, M fixed nuclei of arbitrary positions and charges $Z_j\geq 1$ and total $Z=sum$ $Z_j$, is strict n-electron binding possible only for $n\leq Z+CM$ for one universal constant C independent of charges and positions? Also ask that adding electrons above that threshold does not lower the ground energy.

title: Generic C1 future inextendibility near rotating subextremal Kerr

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every fixed Kerr mass $M>0$ and nonzero $|a|<M$, is there a sufficiently small weighted-smooth neighborhood of its asymptotically flat vacuum initial datum in which data admitting a future C1 Lorentzian extension of the full maximal development form a meagre set?

title: Generic C2 future inextendibility near rotating subextremal Kerr

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every fixed rotating subextremal Kerr datum, do future C2-extendible vacuum maximal developments form a meagre set in a sufficiently small neighborhood in the specified weighted smooth initial-data topology?

title: Generic weak future inextendibility near a fixed rotating Kerr datum

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every fixed Kerr mass $M>0$ and nonzero subextremal rotation $|a|<M$, is there a sufficiently small neighborhood of its asymptotically flat vacuum initial datum, in the stated weighted smooth topology, in which future $C^0$ intersect $W^{1,2}_loc-extendible$ maximal developments form a meagre set? Equivalently ask for a residual set of weakly future-inextendible data.

title: The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter enclosing-area inequality

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For smooth complete one-ended orientable three-dimensional asymptotically hyperbolic exteriors with cosmological constant $-3$, compact smooth boundary, the stated weighted-integrable DEC and $O_{2,\alpha }/O_{1,\alpha }$ hyperbolic-norm decay of rate $3/2<\tau <3$, future-timelike metric mass covector and $H+\operatorname{tr}_S$ $K\leq 0$ on every boundary component, is $m_AH\geq (r_A+r_A^3)/2$ for $r_A=\operatorname{sqrt}(A_min/(4\pi ))$? No maximality, compact-topology, boundary-genus or outermostness restriction is imposed; ask for the stated connected nondegenerate original-data Schwarzschild–AdS equality rigidity.

title: Conformal stress improvement in the finite-scaling-support operational framework

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For four-dimensional operational quantum field theories satisfying all source framework assumptions, including algebraic direct-sum decomposition and finite scaling support for every original field, must the dimension-three virial divergence equal Box L for a physical Hermitian scalar L of dimension two, allowing a symmetric conserved traceless stress improvement with unchanged translation and Lorentz Ward charges and unbroken local conformal Ward identities?

title: The universal radius containing all but m electrons of neutral atoms

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every choice of normalized full Coulomb neutral-atom ground states $Psi_Z$, let $R_m(Psi_Z)$ be the radius at which the expected number of electrons outside the ball is m. Do $m^{1/3}\limsup _{Z\to infinity,Z>m}$ $R_m$ and $m^{1/3}\liminf _{Z\to infinity,Z>m}$ $R_m$ both tend to $(81\pi ^2/2)^{1/3}$ as integer m$\to$infinity? The inner limits keep m fixed.

title: A uniform gap in the periodic spin-one antiferromagnetic chain

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For the standard spin-one periodic Hamiltonian $H_L=sum_j$ $S_j\cdot S_{j+1}$ and even lengths L, is the ground state unique for all sufficiently large L and is the spectral gap bounded below by a strictly positive constant independent of L? Use $[S^a,S^b]=i$ $\epsilon _abc$ $S^c$ and $sum_a(S^a)^2=2$.

title: A parity lower bound for bounded-depth quantum circuits with polynomial ancillas

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Fix depth d, total-qubit exponent $c\geq 1$ and $\epsilon >0$. For all sufficiently large input lengths n, is parity impossible with success at least 1/2+epsilon on every input using depth-d circuits of arbitrary one-qubit gates and unbounded-arity Toffoli gates on at most $n^c$ qubits, layers of disjoint supports, zero-state ancillas and one measured output qubit?

title: QAOA reaches the SK ground value when thermodynamic size is taken first

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For zero-field Gaussian SK, let $Q_p$ be the optimum limiting QAOA energy at fixed depth p after n$\to$infinity. Does $Q_p$ tend as p$\to$infinity to the Parisi ground-state value? Equivalently, for each $\epsilon >0$ must one finite depth and deterministic angle vectors independent of n and disorder achieve limiting value at least $P_*-\epsilon $?

title: The Riemannian Penrose bound with minimizing frontiers in every dimension

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: In every $n\geq 3$, let a complete connected one-ended Euclidean exterior have smooth metric through a compact outer-minimizing locally perimeter-minimizing frontier, whose regular part is minimal and whose singular set has dimension at most $n-8$. Assume nonnegative integrable scalar curvature decaying as $O(r^{-n-\beta })$, $\beta >0$, and $g-\delta =O_2(r^{-\tau })$, $\tau >(n-2)/2$. Is $m_ADM\geq (1/2)(H^{n-1}(frontier)/\omega _{n-1})^((n-2)/(n-1))$?

title: Full support of every zero-temperature SK minimizing order parameter

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: If gamma minimizes the stated zero-temperature SK Parisi functional over its admissible class, must its Stieltjes measure have support [0,1), with gamma strictly increasing on every subinterval? Require the associated Parisi diffusion identities $E[u_\gamma (t,X_t)^2]=t$ and $E[Phi_{\gamma ,xx}(t,X_t)^2]=1$ for each $0\leq t<1$. The question does not assert minimizer existence.

title: Original-data rigidity at equality in spacetime Penrose bounds

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For each $n\geq 3$ and the smooth DEC one-ended enclosing-area exterior class with connected nondegenerate outermost outer-minimizing horizon specified in the manuscript, does equality in the neutral spacetime Penrose bound imply a global spacelike embedding of the entire original exterior, including boundary, into the corresponding Schwarzschild–Tangherlini exterior and future horizon? Require the given metric and second fundamental form to be induced exactly, a future normal smooth up to the boundary, and the chosen end approaching spatial infinity.

title: Conformal nets and representation equivalence for strongly rational unitary VOAs

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For every simple unitary strongly rational complex vertex operator algebra, do polynomial energy bounds and CKLW strong locality hold, yielding an irreducible completely rational conformal net? Require complete unitarity, strong integration of all finite-length unitary grading-restricted modules, and the stated braided unitary tensor equivalence from VOA modules to finite-index net representations.

title: The optimal randomized-versus-quantum query exponent for total Boolean functions

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: For bounded-error query complexities of total Boolean functions, is the smallest universal polynomial exponent exactly four: $R(f)=O((1+Q(f))^4)$ for every f, while for every fixed $k\geq 2$ there are total functions $F_{k,m}$, along sufficiently large powers of four m, with $Q\leq C_k$ sqrt(m)(log $m)^{b_k}$ and $R\geq c_k$ $m^{2-1/k}/(\log $ $m)^2$?

title: QMA hardness using only unit-charge nuclei in the continuum

category.name: physics
category.description: Problems at the intersection of mathematics and physics.

statement: Is the full antisymmetric continuum electronic Coulomb ground-energy promise problem QMA-hard when every nucleus has charge one, distinct positions are rational, electron count is unary, and rational thresholds are separated by at least inverse input length? Require deterministic polynomial-time reductions producing polynomially many nuclei and electrons, polynomial bit lengths, and gap at least one.

title: Elliptic-square intersections of Hodge-generic curves in A2

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For a reduced irreducible closed Hodge-generic Qbar-curve in A2, are only finitely many of its abelian surfaces isogenous to E x E for an elliptic curve E?

title: Product-CM intersections of Hodge-generic curves in A2

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let C be a reduced irreducible closed curve over Qbar in the moduli space A2 of principally polarized abelian surfaces, contained in no proper special subvariety. Are there only finitely many points of C whose abelian surface is isogenous to a product of two elliptic curves with at least one factor having complex multiplication?

title: Quaternionic division intersections of Hodge-generic curves in A2

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For a reduced irreducible closed Hodge-generic Qbar-curve C in A2, are there only finitely many points whose abelian surface has rational endomorphism algebra an indefinite quaternion division algebra over Q?

title: Zilber-Pink for abelian varieties over Qbar

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every abelian variety over a number field and every irreducible subvariety X over Qbar, must there be only finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties of X? Atypical intersections are components with dimension greater than the expected dimension of intersection with torsion translates of abelian subgroups, measured inside the smallest such special subvariety containing X.

title: Primitive-root infinitude for every admissible base

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every integer a that is neither -1 nor a perfect square, are there infinitely many primes p not dividing a for which a generates the multiplicative group modulo p?

title: Corrected binary Elliott for ordinary averages

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let f1,f2 be multiplicative functions of modulus at most one. Suppose at least one f satisfies, for every fixed Dirichlet character chi, $inf_{|t|<=N}$ $sum_{p<=N}$ (1-Re(f(p) $conjugate(chi(p)p^{it})))/p$ $->infinity$. For distinct fixed nonnegative h1,h2, must (1/N) $sum_{n<=N}$ f1(n+h1)f2(n+h2) tend to zero?

title: Integral-point density on curve character varieties

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement:
Let $X$ be a smooth connected complex algebraic curve and let $r\ge1$. Write $M_r(X)$ for the character variety of semisimple representations $\pi_1(X)\to\mathrm{SL}_r(\mathbb C)$, with its integral model obtained from a finite presentation of $\pi_1(X)$ and conjugation invariants. Representations have determinant one. If $\overline X\setminus X=\{x_1,\ldots,x_s\}$, choose meridians and quasi-unipotent conjugacy classes $C_i\subset\mathrm{SL}_r(\mathbb C)$; all their eigenvalues are roots of unity. Let $Y\subset M_r(X)_{\mathbb C}$ be the reduced locus where those meridians have the specified conjugacy classes, allowing nonsemisimple boundary matrices.

For a number field $K\subset\mathbb C$ containing the boundary eigenvalues, does there exist one finite extension $L/K$ for which
\[
 M_r(X)(\mathcal O_L)\cap Y(\mathbb C)
\]
is Zariski dense in $Y$, and hence in every irreducible component? Integrality means extension to the ambient character variety over the full ring of integers $\mathcal O_L$; it does not require membership in a strict locally closed integral boundary model at every finite prime. Ask also for the version fixing only the boundary characteristic polynomials with roots of unity, and for density in the entire character variety without boundary conditions. In the latter version take $K=\mathbb Q$. The same extension must work throughout the selected locus and all its components.

title: The exact BSD formula at low Selmer corank

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every elliptic curve E over Q, if its p-primary full Selmer group has $Z_p$ corank zero or one for at least one prime p, must analytic rank equal Mordell-Weil rank, must the entire Tate-Shafarevich group be finite, and must the leading coefficient of L(E,s) at $s=1$ equal the BSD expression using the Neron period, regulator, full Sha order, finite Tamagawa factors and rational torsion order?

title: Generic Ramanujan for exceptional groups over function fields

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Over every global function field F, is every local component of every complex globally generic cuspidal representation of a split connected adjoint absolutely simple group of type G2,F4,E6,E7 or E8 tempered, including arbitrarily ramified places and every characteristic?

title: An explicit asymptotic formula for the number of totients

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Determine a fully specified asymptotic equivalent for the number $V(x)=\#\{m\leq x:m=\phi(n)\text{ for some positive integer }n\}$ of distinct totient values at most $x$, counting each value once.

title: Odd regular Fontaine-Mazur over Q at two

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Must every continuous irreducible odd two-dimensional representation of the absolute Galois group of Q over $Qbar_2$, unramified outside finitely many primes and de Rham at two with distinct Hodge-Tate weights, be a Tate twist of the representation of a classical cuspidal eigenform?

title: Full finite-level Ramanujan-Arthur decomposition

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let X/Fq be smooth projective geometrically connected, G/Fq split connected semisimple, and D any effective divisor. Consider compactly supported cuspidal functions on $G(F)\backslash G(A_F)$ at full congruence level D. For each nilpotent orbit O of the dual group choose its SL2 homomorphism phi, and at a good degree-d place require the unramified Satake class to lie in $\phi (\operatorname{diag}(q^{d/2},q^{-d/2}))$ times a semisimple element of the centralizer whose eigenvalues in every algebraic representation have modulus one under every complex embedding. Must the associated orbit-indexed cuspidal subspaces give a direct-sum decomposition of the whole space, both over Q and over $Qbar_\ell $, with no restriction on D or characteristic?

title: Global Arthur enhancements of occurring excursion parameters

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Assume the orbit-indexed Ramanujan-Arthur decomposition of cuspidal functions at full finite level. For a split connected semisimple group over a finite field and a cuspidal excursion parameter sigma on the Weil group of the unramified open curve, does there exist a dual-group SL2 homomorphism phi and a continuous homomorphism tau to its full centralizer, both over one finite $Q_\ell $ extension, such that tau has reductive Zariski closure and all Frobenius eigenvalues have modulus one under every complex embedding, while after a single global conjugation $\sigma (w)=\tau (w)$ $\phi (\operatorname{diag}(a^deg(w),a^-deg(w)))$ for every Weil element w, including inertia, with a matching choice of square root of q?

title: Goldfeld analytic rank density over Q

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Fix any elliptic curve E over Q, and order its quadratic twists by signed squarefree integer parameters d with $0<|d|<=X$. Must twists of analytic rank zero and twists of analytic rank one each have natural proportion tending to one half, with all higher analytic ranks having density zero?

title: Mean analytic rank of quadratic twists over Q

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every elliptic curve E over Q, does the mean of the analytic ranks of $E^{d}$, over nonzero signed squarefree d with $|d|<=X$, tend to one half as X tends to infinity?

title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every elliptic curve E over every imaginary quadratic field K, is its compatible system of first-etale-cohomology representations realized by a weight-zero GL2 automorphic representation with matching local Weil-Deligne data at every finite place and the expected complex-place parameter, with cuspidality for non-CM curves and automorphic induction or isobaric summation in CM cases?

title: The joint Dickman law for consecutive integers

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For fixed a,b in (0,1), is the natural density of integers $n>=2$ with largest prime factor of n at most $n^a$ and that of n+1 at most $n^b$ equal to rho(1/a)rho(1/b)? Here $\rho (u)=1$ on [0,1] and u $\rho '(u)=-\rho (u-1)$ for $u>1$.

title: Milnor K reconstruction at the characteristic prime

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement:
Fix a prime $p$. Let $K/k$ and $L/l$ be finitely generated extensions of algebraically closed fields of characteristic $p$, with $\operatorname{trdeg}(K/k),\operatorname{trdeg}(L/l)\ge2$. For $F=K,L$, set
\[
 V_F=F^\times/(F^\times)^p,\qquad
 R_F=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb F_p}\{[a]\otimes[1-a]:a\in F\setminus\{0,1\}\}.
\]
The class $[a]$ uses additive notation for the multiplicative quotient. The degree-two Milnor group is $(V_F\otimes_{\mathbb F_p}V_F)/R_F=K_2^M(F)/p$. Define
\[
 \operatorname{Isom}_{\mathrm M}(V_K,V_L)
 =\{\Theta:V_K\xrightarrow{\sim}V_L\text{ linear over }\mathbb F_p:
           (\Theta\otimes\Theta)(R_K)=R_L\}.
\]
The maps are required to be invertible, and to carry the relation space onto the target relation space. Let $\operatorname{Isom}(K,k;L,l)$ consist of field isomorphisms carrying $k$ onto $l$. Is the natural map
\[
 \operatorname{Isom}(K,k;L,l)\longrightarrow
 \operatorname{Isom}_{\mathrm M}(V_K,V_L)/\mathbb F_p^\times,
 \qquad\alpha\longmapsto[\alpha_*],
\]
a bijection, where $\alpha_*([a])=[\alpha(a)]$ and the quotient identifies linear isomorphisms differing by one nonzero scalar?

title: Tame eigensheaves at several marked points

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let $n>=2$ and $p>n$. Let X be a smooth projective geometrically connected genus-at-least-two curve over an algebraic closure of a finite field, with at least two distinct finite-field rational marked points. For every Zariski-dense geometric PGLn parameter on the punctured curve over a finite extension of $Q_\ell $, killing wild inertia and having tame $\exp (t_\ell $ $N_x)$ monodromy for an arbitrary nilpotent $N_x$ at each mark, must there be a nonzero locally constructible perverse sheaf on SLn-bundles with Borel reduction at all marks, parabolic global-nilpotent singular support, and coherent all-leg Hecke eigenisomorphisms with collision fusion? Zero residues are allowed and no Frobenius descent is required.

title: Ordinary binary affine Liouville correlations

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement:
Let $\Omega(n)$ count prime factors with multiplicity and put $\lambda(n)=(-1)^{\Omega(n)}$ for positive integers $n$. Fix integers $a_1,a_2\ge1$ and $b_1,b_2\ge0$ with $a_1b_2-a_2b_1\ne0$. Must
\[
 \sum_{1\le n\le X}\lambda(a_1n+b_1)\lambda(a_2n+b_2)=o(X)
 \qquad(X\to\infty)
\]
hold through all real cutoffs $X$?

title: Additive indecomposability of finite modifications of the primes

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For any two subsets A,B of the nonnegative integers, each containing at least two elements, must their sumset differ from the prime set at infinitely many integers?

title: Patterson first moment over Eisenstein primes

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: In Z[omega], $\omega =\exp (2\pi $ i/3), let primary primes pi satisfy $\pi =1$ modulo3, let $chi_\pi $ be the cubic residue character, and put $G(\pi )=N(\pi )^{-1/2}$ $sum_(v$ modulo pi) $chi_\pi (v)$ exp(2pi i Tr(v/pi)). Is $sum_(N(\pi )<=X)$ G(pi) asymptotic to $(6/5)(2\pi )^{2/3}/(3$ Gamma(2/3)) times $X^{5/6}/\log $ X, counting all primary prime elements including conjugate split primes?

title: Positive lower density of arbitrarily large normalized prime gaps

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: If $p_n$ is the nth prime, must the set of indices n with $p_{n+1}-p_n>C$ log $p_n$ have positive lower natural density for every fixed $C>0$? The positive density may depend on C.

title: Power-free values of irreducible polynomials of degrees four to eight

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For irreducible f in Z[x] of degree d in \{4,5,6,7,8\}, set $k=d-2$ and suppose no prime p has $p^k$ dividing every value f(n). Does the count of positive $n<=X$ for which f(n) has no prime-kth-power divisor equal $c_{f,k}$ X+o(X), where $c_{f,k}$ is the positive product over primes of 1 minus the proportion of roots of f modulo $p^k$?

title: Prime predecessors with even squarefree factor count

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Are there infinitely many primes p such that p-1 is squarefree and has an even number of prime factors?

title: Poisson-Dirichlet factorization of prime predecessors

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For each prime $p>=3$ list the prime factors of p-1, counting multiplicity, in descending order and divide their logarithms by log(p-1), padding with zeros. Do the first k coordinates, for every fixed k, converge in distribution under ordinary uniform prime counting $p<=X$ to the decreasing rearrangement of the stick-breaking sequence U1,(1-U1)U2,(1-U1)(1-U2)U3,... for independent uniform Uj on (0,1)?

title: Bogomolov-Pop pro-ell reconstruction

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let K/k and L/l have transcendence degree at least two over arbitrary algebraically closed constants of characteristic different from ell. Does the maximal abelian pro-ell Galois quotient, equipped with its commutator-lifting structure from the abelian-by-central quotient, determine every isomorphism of their perfect closures, with the canonical bijection using Frobenius equivalence on fields and a common $Z_\ell -unit$ scalar on Galois maps?

title: The eleven-twelfths zero-free half-plane

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Do all Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta, and all finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt(-3)) have no zeros in $Re(s)>11/12$, with any principal-character pole at one allowed?

title: The seven-eighths zero-free half-plane

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Do all Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta, and all finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt(-3)) have no zeros in $Re(s)>7/8$, allowing a pole at one for the principal character?

title: Rationality of the canonical unramified Arthur filtration

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let X/Fq be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve and G/Fq split connected semisimple. Assume that the Lie algebra admits an invariant nondegenerate symmetric form nondegenerate on every Levi center, Chevalley restriction is an isomorphism for every Levi, semisimple Lie-element scheme centralizers are Levi subgroups, and every nilpotent Lie element over every extension belongs to the Lie algebra of the unipotent radical of an extension-defined parabolic. Let $A_E$ be finitely supported E-valued functions on the finite-field G-bundle isomorphism classes, $E=Qbar_\ell $. For any closed invariant subset Y of the dual Lie-algebra nilpotent cone, let $F_Y$ $A_E$ be the image of categorical Frobenius trace from the corresponding derived-Satake nilpotent-support subcategory. Must E $tensor_Q$ $(A_Q$ intersect $F_Y$ $A_E)$ map isomorphically to $F_Y$ $A_E$ for every ell different from p, yielding a common rational filtration independent of ell?

title: Constructible tame eigensheaves with regular monodromy

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let X be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over an algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic p, with a finite-field rational marked point x, and let G be split simple simply connected. Assume that the Lie algebra admits an invariant nondegenerate symmetric form nondegenerate on every Levi center, Chevalley restriction is an isomorphism for every Levi, semisimple Lie-element scheme centralizers are Levi subgroups, and every nilpotent Lie element over every extension belongs to the Lie algebra of the unipotent radical of an extension-defined parabolic. For every Zariski-dense geometric dual-group parameter on X minus x over a finite extension of $Q_\ell $, ell different from p, killing wild inertia and having tame monodromy $\exp (t_\ell $ N) for regular nilpotent N, is there a nonzero locally constructible perverse ell-adic sheaf on G-bundles with Borel reduction at x, with parabolic nilpotent singular support and coherent all-leg Hecke eigenisomorphisms, including fusion at collisions? No arithmetic descent of the parameter is assumed.

title: Restricted geometric Langlands in the stated positive-characteristic regimes

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic $p>0$, ell different from p, X a smooth projective curve and G connected reductive. Assume that the Lie algebra admits an invariant nondegenerate symmetric form nondegenerate on every Levi center, Chevalley restriction is an isomorphism for every Levi, semisimple Lie-element scheme centralizers are Levi subgroups, and every nilpotent Lie element over every extension belongs to the Lie algebra of the unipotent radical of an extension-defined parabolic. Assume either descent of k,X,G from a finite field with k its algebraic closure, or that p is very good for G and does not divide its Weyl-group order. Must the existing primed restricted geometric Langlands functor have full spectral support, giving a QCoh-linear equivalence from ell-adic sheaves on $Bun_G$ with nilpotent singular support to IndCoh with nilpotent support on the entire restricted dual-group local-system prestack?

title: Many primes with power-smooth predecessors

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For each fixed delta in (0,1/4), does the number of primes p in (2x,5x] whose predecessor p-1 has no prime factor exceeding $x^\delta $ grow at least as $x^(1-o(1))$ as x tends to infinity? The error exponent may depend on delta.

title: Open homomorphisms of solvably closed global Galois groups

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let F1,F2 be number fields and let $E_i/F_i$ be possibly infinite Galois extensions such that $E_i$ has no nontrivial abelian algebraic extension. Must every continuous homomorphism $Gal(E1/F1)->Gal(E2/F2)$ with open image be induced by a unique field embedding E2 into E1?

title: Dimension of the full two-adic Hecke algebra at odd level

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Fix any odd positive N. For each k take the Z-algebra generated by prime-to-2N Hecke operators $T_l$ and l $S_l$ on the sum of all weight-i level-Gamma1(N) modular forms, including Eisenstein forms, for $1<=i<=k$; here $S_l$ acts in weight i by $l^{i-2}$ times the diamond operator. Complete each algebra by tensoring with Z2 and take their inverse limit under restriction. Must every irreducible component of its spectrum have Krull dimension exactly four?

title: The two-primary BSD formula at low two-Selmer corank

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every elliptic curve E over Q with full 2-power Selmer $Z_2-corank$ at most one, must analytic and Mordell-Weil ranks agree, must whole Sha be finite, and must the BSD-normalized leading L-value be a positive rational number whose 2-adic valuation equals that of the Sha order? No rational two-torsion or reduction-type hypothesis is imposed.

title: Unramified generic Ramanujan over function fields

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Over every global function field F, let G be split connected adjoint absolutely simple and pi a complex cuspidal automorphic representation. If pi has a generic unramified component at even one place, must its component be tempered at every unramified place?

title: Unrestricted odd two-adic pro-modularity over Q

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every continuous absolutely irreducible odd representation r of Gal(Qbar/Q) in GL2(E), where E is a finite extension of Q2, unramified outside finitely many finite primes, is there an odd level N containing every odd ramified prime and a continuous Z2-algebra map from the full prime-to-2N, all-weight level-Gamma1(N) Hecke algebra to the integers of E that sends $T_l$ to $\operatorname{tr}(r(Frob_l))$ and l $S_l$ to $det(r(Frob_l))$ at every l not dividing 2N? No de Rham condition is imposed.

title: Weak inhomogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Fix a real shift gamma and a finite-valued nonnegative function psi on positive integers. If $sum_q$ phi(q)psi(q)/q diverges, must almost every real x satisfy $||qx-\gamma ||<\psi (q)$ for infinitely many q, with no coprimality restriction on the approximating numerator?

title: Weil structures on regular tame eigensheaves

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Let $n>=2,p>n,\ell $ different from p, and let X/Fq be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two with a rational marked point x. For an arithmetic PGLn parameter on X minus x over a finite extension of $Q_\ell $ whose geometric image is Zariski dense and whose inertia at x is wild-trivial regular-unipotent tame $\exp (t_\ell $ N), must some finite constant-field extension support a nonzero Weil sheaf on SLn-bundles with Borel reduction at x, geometrically locally constructible perverse with nilpotent singular support, and coherent all-leg Hecke eigenisomorphisms as Weil sheaves?

title: Finite étale covers with a prescribed exterior sheet and p-divisible disk degrees

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: Fix a prime p, a finite extension $k/Q_p$, its algebraic closure and completed algebraic closure Omega. Let X over the algebraic closure be a smooth proper connected curve of genus at least two. Choose finitely many disjoint open disks $V_i$ of positive value-group radii strictly inside rational parameter charts, so that $U=X^an$ minus their union is nonempty and contains an Omega-rational point. Does one smooth proper connected curve Y admit a finite etale surjective morphism to X with a component over U mapping isomorphically to U and every component over every prescribed $V_i$ having degree divisible by p, without shrinking the disks?

title: Margulis–Platonov normal subgroups over global function fields

category.name: number_theory
category.description: Properties of integers, prime numbers, Diophantine equations.

statement: For every global function field k, and every absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic k-group G, let A consist of the places v where G has $k_v-\operatorname{rank}$ zero, set $H_A=product_(v$ in $A)G(k_v)$, and let $\delta _A$ be the diagonal map. Is every abstract normal subgroup N of G(k) not contained in its center equal to $\delta _A^{-1}(W)$ for an open normal subgroup W of $H_A$? Include all positive characteristics and anisotropic G.

title: Absolute bicentralizer conjecture for type III₁ factors

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every type $III_{1}$ factor M with separable predual and every faithful normal state $\varphi $, is its bicentralizer $BC(M,\varphi )$ equal to the scalar operators?

title: Abstract Cuntz-semigroup criterion for Jiang–Su absorption

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every separable nuclear complex C*-algebra A, is $A\cong A\otimes Z$ equivalent to an abstract isomorphism $Cu(A)\cong Cu(A\otimes Z)$ in the category Cu, without requiring that isomorphism to arise from the first-factor inclusion or any star-homomorphism?

title: Approximation paving for every MASA

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Is there a universal C such that, for each $0<\varepsilon <1$, every self-adjoint x in a complex von Neumann algebra M and every MASA $A\subseteq M$ can be strongly approximated by self-adjoint y of norm $\leq 3||x||$, with a partition $(p_i)$ in A into at most $C\varepsilon ^-6$ pieces and a self-adjoint $a\in A$ of norm $\leq ||y||$ satisfying $||\sum p_iyp_i-a||\leq \varepsilon ||y||$? No separability or expectation is assumed.

title: Quadratic strong-operator paving for every MASA

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every MASA $A\subseteq M\subseteq B(H)$, self-adjoint $x\in M$ and $0<\varepsilon <1$, can one fix $r\leq 5\cdot 10^{8}\varepsilon ^-2$ before any strong neighborhood is chosen, so that for every finite $F\subset H$ and $\delta >0$ there are an r-partition $(p_i)$ of 1 in A, self-adjoint $a\in A$ with $||a||\leq ||x||$, and a projection $q\in M$ with $||(1-q)\xi ||<\delta $ for $\xi \in F$ and $||q(\sum p_ixp_i-a)q||\leq \varepsilon ||x||$, without an expectation or separability assumption?

title: Bounded recovery of modular spectral averages

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Let M carry a faithful normal state $\varphi $ with $M_\varphi =C1$, put $\xi =\varphi ^{1/2}$ and $D=\log $ $\Delta _\varphi $ on $L^{2}(M)$. For fixed $T\in B(L^{2}(M))$ and $s\in R$, if unit vectors in intervals of D shrinking to s have a positive limsup for the fixed symmetric translation-invariant orbit mean of ||T $\exp (itD)h||^{2}$, can a subsequence be replaced by $v_j\xi $ for uniformly operator-norm-bounded $v_j\in M$, with $||Tv_j\xi ||$ bounded below and spectral widths at most four times the original widths?

title: Equivariant Jiang–Su absorption for amenable actions

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If a countable amenable group acts on a separable simple unital infinite-dimensional nuclear stably finite Z-stable complex C*-algebra, is that action cocycle conjugate to its tensor product with the trivial action on Z, without an outerness, trace-action or UCT assumption?

title: Removing a fixed amplification in exact C*-algebras

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If C is an exact complex C*-algebra and one fixed integer $n\geq 1$ makes $h^{\oplus n}$ properly infinite for every $h\in C_+$, must each h itself be properly infinite and C strongly purely infinite? Consequently, in the separable nuclear setting does this fixed-amplification hypothesis imply absorption of $O\infty $?

title: Single generation of separable-predual finite factors

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Does every type $II_{1}$ factor with separable predual have one bounded operator x with $W*(x)=M$, equivalently two self-adjoint von Neumann generators? This asks for von Neumann generation and makes no norm-closed C*-generation assertion.

title: Individual and strong pure infiniteness

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If every positive element of a complex C*-algebra is properly infinite in Cuntz comparison, must the algebra be strongly purely infinite, with simultaneous two-element diagonalization, without exactness, nuclearity, unitality or simplicity assumptions?

title: Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every torsion-free discrete group G, are 0 and 1 the only projections in the scalar reduced group C*-algebra C*r(G)? This concerns the completed complex C*-algebra, rather than the algebraic group ring or only matrix projections.

title: Higher bounded Hochschild cohomology of von Neumann algebras

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every complex von Neumann algebra M and every integer $k\geq 2$, is each bounded k-cocycle with coefficients in M a bounded coboundary, that is $H^k(M,M)=0$, without a complete-boundedness or separability restriction?

title: Kaplansky quasitrace additivity conjecture

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Is every normalized two-quasitrace on every unital complex C*-algebra additive on the positive cone and therefore a tracial state, including separable algebras without exactness or nuclearity?

title: Equality of microstates and nonmicrostates free entropy

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every bounded finite self-adjoint tuple in a tracial von Neumann algebra for which both entropies are finite, must classical microstates free entropy $\chi $, with its original operator-norm cutoff and limsup convention, equal nonmicrostates free entropy $\chi *$?

title: Filtered smash products of cobordism-null restrictions

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Given a finite pointed CW pair $G\subseteq E$ and a based map $v:E\to S^d$ whose stable restriction to G becomes null after the unit $S\to MU$, does $v^{\wedge \ell }$ become stably null on the union of smash products with at least $ceil(\ell /2)$ factors restricted to G, for every sufficiently large $\ell $?

title: Jiang–Su absorption from Cuntz-semigroup regularity

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Let A be a separable nuclear complex C*-algebra. Suppose that, for every $x,y\in Cu(A)$ and integer $l\geq 1$, $(l+1)x\leq ly$ implies $x\leq y$, and for every $x\in Cu(A)$ and integer $N\geq 1$ there is one $u\in Cu(A)$ satisfying $Nu\leq x\leq (N+1)u$. Must A absorb Z? These are the full ordered-semigroup conditions, allowing zero and infinite functionals and arbitrary ideals.

title: Small spatial embeddings from one-way near-inclusions

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Does arbitrarily small one-way unit-ball distance from a unital von Neumann algebra M to N, acting on the same Hilbert space, force a unitary u arbitrarily close to 1 with $uMu*\subseteq N$? The claim concerns small implementing unitaries, not the existence of an unrestricted spatial embedding.

title: Phillips–Toms radius-of-comparison formula for minimal integer actions

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every minimal homeomorphism h of an infinite compact metrizable space X, is $rc(C(X)\rtimes _hZ)=mdim(X,h)/2$, allowing the value infinity? In particular is zero mean dimension equivalent to the small boundary property, Z-stability and finite nuclear dimension of the crossed product?

title: Hyperinvariant subspaces for quasinilpotent Hilbert-space operators

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Must every nonzero quasinilpotent bounded operator on a separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert space have a nonzero proper closed subspace invariant under every bounded operator commuting with it?

title: Relative bicentralizer and continuous-core commutants

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every unital inclusion $N\subseteq M$ of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals and a faithful normal conditional expectation $M\to N$, is there a unital injective subalgebra $P\subseteq N$ and a faithful normal conditional expectation $N\to P$ for which $P\prime \cap c(M)=N\prime \cap c(M)$, where c(M) is the continuous core?

title: Uniform Gamma from tracial-ultrapower real rank zero

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Let A be simple separable unital infinite-dimensional nuclear stably finite with nonempty tracial-state space, and let B be its uniform tracial completion. For any free ultrafilter $\omega $, does real rank zero of the designated uniform tracial ultrapower $B^\omega $ in its quotient C*-norm imply uniform property Gamma for A?

title: Kirchberg–Rørdam central-sequence character criterion

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every nonzero unital separable complex C*-algebra A and every free ultrafilter $\omega $ on N, is $A\cong A\otimes Z$ equivalent to absence of nonzero characters on the norm central-sequence algebra $A^\omega \cap A\prime $, without nuclearity or simplicity assumptions?

title: Dimension-one bound after Jiang–Su stabilization for separable nuclear C*-algebras

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every separable nuclear complex C*-algebra A, including nonunital and nonsimple algebras, must $dim_nuc(A\otimes Z)\leq 1$?

title: Arithmetic classification of twisted lattice correspondences

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Let $\Gamma $ be a countably infinite ICC group commensurable with a property-(T) lattice in a finite nonempty product $H_i(k_i)^+$, where $k_i$ is R, C or a finite extension of $Q_p$ (with primes allowed to differ), each $H_i$ is a connected adjoint absolutely simple algebraic group, $H_i(k_i)^+$ is generated by the $k_i-points$ of unipotent radicals of proper parabolic subgroups, and each such topological group is noncompact and has property (T), and $\Lambda $ any countably infinite ICC group. For arbitrary normalized circle-valued cocycles $\mu $ and $\omega $, is every bifinite $L_\mu (\Gamma )–L_\omega (\Lambda )$ correspondence a closed summand of finitely many models obtained by induction from actual isomorphisms between finite-index subgroups and finite-dimensional projective representations with multiplier $\mu /\delta *\omega $?

title: Stable recovery of twisted lattice factors

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For an ICC group $\Gamma $ in the class of groups abstractly commensurable with lattices in a finite nonempty product $H_i(k_i)^+$, where $k_i$ is R, C or a finite extension of $Q_p$ (with primes allowed to differ), each $H_i$ is a connected adjoint absolutely simple algebraic group, $H_i(k_i)^+$ is generated by the $k_i-points$ of unipotent radicals of proper parabolic subgroups, and each such topological group is noncompact and has property (T), an arbitrary countably infinite ICC group $\Lambda $, normalized scalar cocycles $\mu ,\omega $ and positive scales t,s, does $L_\mu (\Gamma )^t\cong L_\omega (\Lambda )^s$ hold exactly when $t=s$ and a group isomorphism $\Gamma \to \Lambda $ carries $\omega $ to $\mu $ up to a scalar coboundary, with every specified factor isomorphism implemented by that group/cochain map and an inner corner equivalence?

title: Universal strong Kadison–Kastler stability for von Neumann algebras

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every $\varepsilon >0$, is there $\delta >0$ such that any two unital von Neumann algebras on the same complex Hilbert space, with the same identity and two-sided unit-ball Hausdorff distance below $\delta $, are conjugate by a unitary u satisfying $||u-1||<\varepsilon $? The bound must be independent of both algebras and of the Hilbert space.

title: The optimal one-third stability exponent for compact-target Brenier maps

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: Fix $d\geq 2$, a convex body $K\subset R^d$ with nonempty interior, its uniform probability rho, and a compact target set Y. Is there C(K,Y) such that $||T_\mu -T_\nu ||_(L2(\rho ))\leq C$ $W_2(\mu ,\nu )^{1/3}$ for every pair of target probability measures on Y, including atomic and singular measures? Is no larger universal exponent possible even for cube source and target and exactly three target atoms?

title: Stable amplitude blowup for a supercritical defocusing torus equation

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: Does the defocusing power NLS i $partial_t$ u+Delta $u-|u|^{p-1}u=0$ on $T^12$ admit an odd $p\geq 3$, finite integer $k>8$ and a nonempty open set in $H^k$ such that every initial datum in that set has finite-time classical $H^k$ blowup? Require a point $x_*$ and $c_0>0$ with $(T-t)^(1/(p-1))|u(t,x_*)|\to c_0$.

title: Halting detection with one additional decay power per time derivative

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: At fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively encoded into smooth mean-zero forcing and a unique zero-data global smooth Navier–Stokes flow on $T^3$, both obeying $||partial_t^j$ $D_x^\alpha $ $field(t)||_infinity\leq C_{j,\alpha }(1+t)^{-1-j}$, while one fixed particle enters one fixed strip exactly on halting? Permit either a zero-pressure force or its divergence-free projection with unchanged velocity.

title: Computation by a fixed particle with eventually stationary forcing

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: At every fixed positive computable viscosity, can a finite machine and input effectively determine smooth mean-zero forcing on $T^3$, independent of time after $t=1$ and with every derivative globally bounded, whose zero-data Navier–Stokes solution is globally smooth, classically unique and has uniformly bounded energy, while one fixed particle enters one fixed open strip exactly if the encoded machine halts?

title: The interior crack structure of fidelity Mumford–Shah absolute minimizers

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For a reduced absolute minimizer (u,K) of $integral_(Omega$ minus K)|grad $u|^2$ + $integral_Omega|u-g|^2$ + $H^1(K)$ in a bounded planar Lipschitz domain with bounded datum g, must every interior crack point locally lie on a single $C^{1,\alpha }$ arc, a terminal $C^{1,\alpha }$ arc, or a triple of such arcs meeting at 120 degrees? Require only finitely many global crack components to meet each relatively compact interior open set.

title: Computation by compactly supported eventually periodic box transport

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For every machine and input and positive computable viscosity, do effective coefficients $f_0,f_1$ on $R^3$ yield $f=f_0+\nu $ $f_1$ and a zero-data smooth Navier–Stokes solution with pressure zero, both supported in one fixed compact spatial set and having globally bounded mixed derivatives, one-periodic after $t=1$, whose particle from (4,0,0) enters $(-1,2)^3$ exactly on halting? Require uniqueness in the stated C H2 intersect C1 L2 comparison class and, for a fixed machine, an input-independent repeated field.
