title: Halting detection by integrated velocity on a planar-periodic fluid domain

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: At fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input effectively determine a smooth force on $R^2×T$, with every mixed derivative globally bounded and horizontally compact support on each finite interval, and a unique global zero-pressure smooth viscous flow with integrable nonnegative $u_3$, such that $integral_{{X_2>0}×T}u_3(t)>1/2$ for some t exactly if the machine halts?

title: A velocity-field halting detector in forced viscous flow

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: At fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively realized by a unique zero-pressure global smooth forced Navier–Stokes flow on $T^3$, whose force has horizontal support in a time-independent compact subset of $(0,1)^2$ and finite-interval derivative bounds, such that some velocity component $u_3$ exceeds 1/2 in the fixed strip $1/32<y<1/8$ at some time exactly if the machine halts?

title: The Gaussian hard-sphere fluctuation field on regular Boltzmann intervals

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For the source-conditioned grand-canonical hard-sphere gas in the three-dimensional Boltzmann–Grad regime, assuming a uniformly Gaussian-bounded regular kinetic solution on [0,T], do all finite collections of centered empirical-field smooth-test values converge jointly to the Gaussian field solving the linearized Boltzmann equation with white-in-time collision noise? Require Poisson initial covariance integral $f_0$ phi psi, independent initial field and noise, and the source collision covariance $integral_0^(min(t,s))$ $C_r(\phi ,\psi )dr$.

title: The entire weighted Lane–Emden nonexistence criterion

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For each $n\geq 2$, $p,q>0$ and real A,B with $(n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1)>n-2$, are there no positive everywhere functions $u,v\in C(R^n)\cap C2(R^n$ minus \{0\}) satisfying $-$Delta $u=|x|^A$ $v^p$ and $-$Delta $v=|x|^B$ $u^q$ at every $x\neq 0$?

title: Uniform interior gradient Hölder estimates for infinity-harmonic functions

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For every $d\geq 3$, are there $\alpha _d\in (0,1/3]$ and $C_d<infinity$ such that every bounded continuous viscosity solution of the infinity-Laplace equation on the unit ball belongs to $C^{1,\alpha _d}$ on the half ball and has ||grad $u||_infinity+[grad$ $u]_{C^\alpha _d}\leq C_d$ $osc_{B1}u$?

title: A fixed-particle halting detector with time-square-integrable fluid derivatives

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For every fixed positive computable viscosity, can each machine and finite input be effectively assigned smooth mean-zero forcing on $T^3$ with a unique global classical viscous flow so that every mixed derivative of force and velocity has time-dependent supremum norm in both $L_infinity(0,infinity)$ and L2(0,infinity), while a particle from a fixed initial label enters a fixed open strip exactly on halting? A divergence-free force may be required with the same velocity.

title: Recovery of both metric and U(2) connection from one boundary patch

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For a compact connected smooth manifold M of dimension $n\geq 3$ with smooth boundary and one nonempty open patch Gamma, do equal zero-energy connection-Laplacian Dirichlet-to-Neumann pairings on compactly supported Gamma data determine smooth g and smooth u(2)-valued connection A up to a diffeomorphism Phi and a smooth unitary gauge U fixing Gamma? Explicitly ask $g_2=Phi^*g_1$ and $A_2=U^{-1}(Phi^*A_1)U+U^{-1}dU$, with $Phi|\Gamma =id$ and $U|\Gamma =I$.

title: The exact critical dimension for homogeneous one-phase minimizers

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For the one-phase Bernoulli energy integral(|grad $u|^2+1_{u>0})$, is every nonzero degree-one-homogeneous global minimizer in dimensions 1 through 6 a half-space solution, while a nonflat degree-one-homogeneous global minimizer exists in $R^7$? Thus is the first nonflat homogeneous minimizing dimension exactly seven?

title: Uniqueness of admissible periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann evolution

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For every nonnegative initial density on $T^3×R^3$ with compact velocity support and finite mass, kinetic energy and absolute entropy, must the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation have at most one global admissible renormalized solution satisfying the source mass, momentum, energy and entropy conditions, strong L1 continuity and integrable gain and loss on a common initial interval?

title: Halting detection by a fixed particle under initialized periodic solenoidal forcing

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For each fixed positive computable viscosity, can every deterministic one-tape machine and finite input be effectively encoded into smooth divergence-free mean-zero forcing on $T^3$, with a unique zero-data global classical Navier–Stokes solution, all mixed force and velocity derivatives globally bounded and uniform kinetic energy, such that both fields are one-periodic after initialization and the particle from one fixed label enters one fixed open strip exactly if the machine halts? Require the repeated mechanism for a fixed machine to be independent of its input.

title: Computation under rapidly vanishing force in one fixed spatial box

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For each fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively encoded into a smooth body force supported for all times in one fixed compact box of $R^3$, so that every mixed derivative decays faster than every inverse power of time, the zero-data Navier–Stokes solution has the same support and decay, is globally smooth and unique in the stated finite-interval energy class with zero pressure, and the material trajectory from the origin crosses $x_1<-1$ exactly on halting?

title: Halting detection under reciprocal-time decaying torus forcing

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: At fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively encoded into smooth mean-zero forcing on $T^3$ with $||partial_t^j$ $D_x^\alpha $ $f(t)||_infinity\leq C_{j,\alpha }(1+t)^{-1}$ for every derivative order, and a unique zero-data global smooth Navier–Stokes solution of uniformly bounded kinetic energy, while a fixed particle enters a fixed open set exactly if the machine halts?

title: Smooth anisotropic conductivity uniqueness from a single proper patch

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For each compact connected smooth n-manifold $n\geq 3$ with smooth nonempty boundary, and every nonempty proper relatively open patch Gamma, does equality of the localized scalar Laplace–Beltrami Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps for two smooth metrics imply that they differ by a smooth boundary-through diffeomorphism fixing every point of Gamma?

title: Full-boundary recovery of both smooth isotropic elastic moduli

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For any bounded connected smooth domain in $R^3$, do identical static isotropic-elasticity traction Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps on $H^{1/2}(boundary;R^3)\to H^{-1/2}(boundary;R^3)$ imply equality of both smooth real Lamé functions lambda and mu throughout the domain, assuming $\mu >0$ and $3\lambda +2\mu >0$?

title: Strict hot spots and absence of critical points for smooth planar Neumann ground modes

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For every bounded smooth simply connected planar domain and every nonzero first-positive Neumann Laplacian eigenfunction, including every vector in a multiple first eigenspace, is its gradient nonzero at every interior point and is every interior value strictly between its boundary minimum and maximum?

title: Classification of every bounded stable Allen–Cahn solution in dimension seven

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: Must every stable C2 solution $v:R^7\to [-1,1]$ of Delta $v=v^3-v$ be identically +1 or $-1$, or have the planar form $tanh((a\cdot x-b)/\operatorname{sqrt}(2))$ for a unit vector a and real b, without an energy-growth or asymptotic end-state assumption?

title: The Boltzmann–Grad limit throughout a regular kinetic lifespan

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For the specified stable radial finite-range Newtonian potentials in three dimensions, including the allowed attractive wells, and C1 initial probability density with Gaussian bounds on it and its spatial gradient, assume the associated Boltzmann equation has a nonnegative classical solution uniformly Gaussian-bounded on [0,T]. Does the conditioned product grand-canonical Newtonian gas at Boltzmann–Grad activity $\epsilon ^{-2}$ have every fixed scaled s-particle factorial density converge to $f(t)^tensor-s$ in L1 uniformly on [0,T]?

title: Strong diffeomorphic approximation of three-dimensional homeomorphisms above exponent two

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For every finite $p>2$, arbitrary bounded domains $Omega,Lambda\subset R^3$ and each $W^{1,p}$ homeomorphism f:Omega$\to$Lambda, can f be approximated strongly in $W^{1,p}$ by smooth diffeomorphisms between those same domains? No inverse-map norm or quasiconformal-constant control is imposed.

title: Strong diffeomorphic approximation of three-dimensional Sobolev homeomorphisms up to exponent two

category.name: pde
category.description: PDEs and their applications in physics and geometry.

statement: For arbitrary bounded connected open domains $Omega,Lambda\subset R^3$, every $1\leq p\leq 2$ and every $W^{1,p}$ homeomorphism f:Omega$\to$Lambda, do smooth $W^{1,p}$ diffeomorphisms $f_j$ between the same domains exist with $integral_Omega(|f_j-f|^p+|Df_j-Df|^p)\to 0$? No inverse Sobolev estimate or quasiconformal bound is requested.

title: GOE bulk statistics for weakly disordered regular-graph operators

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed regular degree $d\geq 3$, does sufficiently weak fixed iid Anderson disorder on uniform random d-regular graphs yield a positive continuous bulk density and GOE local point-process limits at every energy in the stated bulk interval, after scaling by that limiting density?

title: The joint GFF and cluster limit of critical Ashkin–Teller currents

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $J>0$ and $U\leq J$ on $sinh(2J)=\exp (-2U)$, do the Ashkin–Teller current height, wired and free cluster collections, and distinguished boundary component converge jointly on every admissible Jordan-domain lattice approximation to the source-normalized GFF, its associated continuum cluster collections, and its specified symmetric two-valued set? Use $H^s_loc$ for every $s<-1$, cluster matching, and Hausdorff convergence for the distinguished component.

title: The exact GFF variance of balanced six-vertex heights

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For square-lattice six-vertex weights $a=b=1$ and fixed $0<c\leq 2$, does the prescribed iterated balanced-torus infinite-volume law exist, and do its rescaled heights modulo constants converge to a planar GFF with variance multiplier 1/arcsin(c/2)? Require joint finite-energy zero-mass measure tests, convergence in the stated negative Besov and Sobolev restriction spaces, and all separated height-increment moments.

title: The sharp singularity exponent of biased symmetric sign matrices

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $p\in (0,1)$ excluding 1/2, let $A_n$ be symmetric with independent signs on and above the diagonal, each +1 with probability p. Is $lim_{n\to \infty }$ P(det $A_n=0)^{1/n}=p^2+(1-p)^2$?

title: A directional zero–one law for finite-range-dependent random environments

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For nearest-neighbor random walk in a stationary ergodic uniformly elliptic environment on $Z^d$, $d\geq 3$, whose rows have the specified finite-dependence independence for separated infinite sets, is the annealed probability of $X_n\cdot \ell \to +infinity$ always zero or one for every deterministic nonzero real direction ell?

title: The exact hierarchical cavity pressure for dilute even-arity spin glasses

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the even-arity dilute Ising models satisfying the Panchenko–Talagrand factorization, integrability and positivity hypotheses, does the thermodynamic mean pressure equal the infimum of the explicit finite-hierarchy cavity trial functional over every finite hierarchy depth and trial law, with convergence also in probability?

title: The nested CLE limit of half-plane double-dimer loops

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the half-plane Temperleyan double-dimer ensemble, do all macroscopic loops converge as curves along the full mesh limit to nested $CLE_4$ in the upper half-plane, in the specified loop-collection matching topology?

title: Strict convexity and differentiability of the exponential planar passage shape

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For nearest-neighbor first-passage percolation on $Z^2$ with independent mean-one exponential edge weights, is the asymptotic unit ball strictly convex with a continuously differentiable boundary? Equivalently ask for differentiability of the time constant at every nonzero direction and no line segment in its unit sphere.

title: Metric–measure universality of subcritical FK and tree-weighted maps

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $q\in (0,4)$ in the stated spherical FK map ensemble, and separately for the spanning-tree-weighted ensemble, is there a deterministic $a_n\to 0$ such that the graph metric multiplied by $a_n$ and the specified probability measure converge through all n to the corresponding unit-area Liouville quantum sphere in Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov law? The root and map decoration are forgotten.

title: Conformal geometry of spherical FK maps at weight four

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For FK weight $q=4$, do canonical conformal embeddings of finite spherical n-edge maps converge jointly in area measure, the full rescaled distance graph and the complete nested loop collection to the critical $\gamma =2$ quantum sphere with its critical metric and loop decoration, for a deterministic $a_n\to 0$ and every $n\to \infty $? Include vanishing spherical flag-triangle mesh.

title: Conformal metric and loop convergence of FK maps below four

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed FK weight $0<q<4$, do canonical flag-triangulation conformal embeddings of spherical n-edge FK maps admit deterministic distance rescalings $a_n\to 0$ so that the area measure, the entire distance graph and every macroscopic nested loop converge jointly, through all n, to the corresponding Liouville quantum sphere and CLE decoration? Require vanishing spherical flag mesh and the stated conditional independence of the loop decoration and embedded marked quantum surface.

title: Joint metric, spectrum and heat-trace limit for FK–Ising maps

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For critical spherical FK–Ising maps with the manuscript graph and stationary-measure conventions, does $(M_n,a_n$ $d_n,\mu _n)$, the complete ordered spectrum (n $\lambda _n,j)_{j\geq 0}$, and the heat trace converge jointly to the sqrt(3)-quantum sphere, its closed Liouville Dirichlet-form spectrum, and its heat trace? Require compact resolvent, constants as the one-dimensional kernel, and locally uniform heat-trace convergence for every positive-time interval.

title: Liouville Brownian motion as the walk limit on FK–Ising maps

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the critical spherical FK–Ising n-edge map law, assume that a deterministic $a_n\to 0$ gives metric–measure convergence to the unit-area sqrt(3)-Liouville quantum sphere. Do any fixed finite number of conditionally independent simple random walks, each initially distributed according to the degree probability measure and accelerated by n, converge jointly with that space to independent stationary Liouville Brownian motions, in the curve-decorated Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov topology?

title: Natural occupation measures of critical FK interfaces

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each $q\in [1,4)$, can a positive deterministic c(q) normalize the medial-edge traversal occupation measure of its critical square-lattice FK Dobrushin interface in the source's fixed unit square with specified boundary marks by $c(q)n^{-d}$, $d=1+\kappa (q)/8$, so that curve and measure converge jointly to one chordal SLE sample and its natural Minkowski-content measure, in ordered curve and weak finite-measure topologies?

title: Joint SLE and CLE limits at FK weights from one through four

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every $q\in [1,4]$, do critical square-lattice FK Dobrushin exploration curves and their nested loop collections converge jointly along every admissible marked Jordan-domain mesh approximation to chordal $SLE_\kappa (q)$ and the corresponding CLE decoration, including $q=4$?

title: The continuum tree limit of FK maps above weight four

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every fixed real $q>4$, is there $c(q)>0$ such that the degree-measured spherical n-edge FK map with graph distance multiplied by $c(q)n^{-1/2}$ converges in Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov law to the Brownian continuum random tree, through all n?

title: Critical square-lattice FK interfaces below random-cluster weight one

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every fixed $q\in (0,1)$, do square-lattice FK Dobrushin interfaces at the self-dual critical edge parameter converge, as unparametrized ordered curves in smooth marked Jordan domains, to chordal SLE with $\kappa =4\pi /arccos(-\operatorname{sqrt}(q)/2)$?

title: A nonlinear-capacity criterion for four-state reconstruction on arbitrary trees

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every deterministic infinite rooted tree with uniformly bounded number of children and $0<\lambda <1$, is four-state reconstruction equivalent to positivity of $sup_\theta $ |theta| over nonnegative root-to-infinity flows satisfying $sup_ray$ $sum_(e$ on $ray)(\lambda ^{-2|e|}\theta (e))^2\leq 1$? Reconstruction means a positive limiting expected total-variation distance of the root posterior from the uniform four-state law.

title: The exact reconstruction threshold of the ferromagnetic four-state channel

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the symmetric four-state broadcast channel $P(j|i)=\lambda $ $1_{i=j}+(1-\lambda )/4$ with $0<\lambda <1$, is reconstruction on every d-ary tree, integer $d\geq 2$, and on the observed Poisson(d) offspring tree for every real $d>0$ possible exactly when d $\lambda ^2>1$, with nonreconstruction at equality?

title: The exact IID-factor threshold for free Ising laws on regular trees

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every $d\geq 3$ and $\beta \geq 0$, is the free zero-field Ising measure on the d-regular tree a factor of iid exactly when $tanh(\beta )\leq (d-1)^{-1/2}$, including equality? In that range ask for a Borel factor commuting with every graph automorphism on every label input.

title: One root-independent IID factor for all free uniform spanning forests

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Is there a single Borel rule, equivariant under graph isomorphisms and independent of a distinguished root, which takes iid uniform vertex labels on every infinite connected locally finite simple unweighted graph to an edge set with that graph’s free uniform spanning forest law?

title: The all-temperature spherical Gaussian perceptron pressure

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the uniform sphere of radius sqrt(N), iid standard Gaussian constraint rows $M=floor(\alpha $ N), every $\alpha ,\beta >0$ and bounded continuous real activation phi, does the normalized log partition function converge in mean and probability to $inf_m$ \{alpha $V_(\beta $ phi)(m)+S(m)\} over the stated monotone trial functions, allowing all finite-entropy trials without requiring $m=1$ near the endpoint?

title: BKT scaling and the endpoint stiffness for finite-range integer heights

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each admissible finite-range symmetric integer-height interaction J in the stated planar class, is the roughening threshold finite and positive, with delocalization including equality? At every $\beta \geq b_c(J)$, ask for full-sequence torus-field convergence to $\operatorname{sqrt}(\beta _eff/v_J^2)$ times a GFF in $H^{-3}$, the matching Laplace functional, $\beta _eff(b_c)=8\pi $ $v_J^2$, an infinite right derivative at $b_c$, and $\beta _eff=\beta +O(\exp (-c_J$ beta)) at high beta. For square spread-out $J_\rho $ also ask $b_c(J_\rho )/(8\pi $ $v_{J_\rho }^2)\to 1$.

title: The mass and mean length of critical bridges in a fixed-width corridor

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For critical honeycomb bridge weights spanning pure cuts at separation R, does there exist $C_0$ such that for every fixed corridor aspect $C\geq C_0$, the confined and unconfined total masses are comparable to $R^{-1/4}$, their first length masses are $R^(13/12+o(1))$, and both normalized mean lengths are $R^(4/3+o(1))$?

title: The fugacity-dependent cylinder exponent for critical honeycomb loops

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the source-defined even-circumference honeycomb cylinder loop partition $Z_N(chi)$ with separating-loop fugacity $chi>0$, is $Z_N(chi)=N^(\tau (chi)+o(1))$, where $\tau =1/6-2(arccos(chi/2))^2/(3\pi ^2)$ for $0<chi\leq 2$ and $\tau =1/6+2(arcosh(chi/2))^2/(3\pi ^2)$ for $chi\geq 2$?

title: Diameter, local mass and covering exponents of fixed-length honeycomb walks

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For a uniformly sampled rooted n-step honeycomb self-avoiding walk, do the following hold with exceptional probability at most $C_{\delta ,k}n^{-k}$ for every $\delta ,k>0:$ diameter between $n^{3/4-\delta }$ and $n^{3/4+\delta }$; visited-vertex count in every radius-s ball centered on the walk between $n^{-\delta }min(n,s^{4/3})$ and $n^\delta $ $min(n,s^{4/3})$; and its radius-s covering number between $n^{-\delta }(1+ns^{-4/3})$ and $n^\delta (1+ns^{-4/3})$, simultaneously for all $1\leq s\leq n$?

title: Critical honeycomb polygon diameter and length exponents

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For simple unoriented honeycomb polygon translation classes with critical weight $w(P)=\rho _v^{|P|}$, define $A(r)=sum_(diam$ $P\geq r)w(P)$, $P(r)=sum_(diam$ $P\geq r)|P|w(P)$ and $M_2(r)=sum_(diam$ $P\leq r)|P|^2w(P)$. Are $A(r)=r^(-2+o(1))$, $P(r)=r^(-2/3+o(1))$ and $M_2(r)\leq r^(2/3+o(1))$, with every indicated sum finite?

title: The length exponent of critical honeycomb chords with fixed endpoints

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For critical honeycomb chords weighted per visited vertex in convex pure lattice hexagons of diameter R converging to a regular hexagon, with prescribed side-interior boundary endpoints separated macroscopically, does length lie in $[R^{4/3-\epsilon },R^{4/3+\epsilon }]$ with probability tending to one for every $\epsilon >0$? Ask the same in the specified nondegenerate half-plane, comparable-width strip and pi/3 or 2pi/3 wedge geometries, uniformly on compact families, with partition mass at least $cR^{-5/4}$.

title: Partition and mean-length exponents for macroscopic triangular honeycomb chords

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the source critical boundary-to-boundary chord ensemble in an equilateral pure-cut honeycomb triangle of scale R, restricted to diameter at least R/100, is its partition mass comparable to $R^{3/4}$ and its expected visited length $R^(4/3+o(1))$? Ask also for the same mean exponent for ordinary center-to-center critical-weight walks with endpoints on the inner boundary layer.

title: The all-temperature pressure of orthogonally invariant Ising disorder

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For $J_N=U_N$ $Lambda_N$ $U_N^T$ with $U_N$ Haar orthogonal, deterministic diagonal $Lambda_N$ whose empirical spectral laws approach compactly supported mu and whose extreme eigenvalues approach the edges of supp(mu), does the uniform-spin Ising pressure converge in mean and almost surely to $inf_p$ ${S(p)+G_1(p)}$, over the stated hierarchical trial measures? No independence of $U_N$ between different dimensions is required.

title: Spherical perceptron pressure with orthogonally invariant disorder

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For $M/N\to \alpha >0$, bi-orthogonally invariant M-by-N disorder whose singular empirical law tends in probability to a compactly supported nu and whose singular values have no outliers from supp(nu), does the bounded-continuous activation pressure converge in probability and mean to a deterministic function of (alpha,nu,f)? Ask for its spectral-block formula obtained by optimizing input squared-norm fractions $\rho _i:$ one-half $sum_i$ $v_i$ $\log (\rho _i/v_i)$, plus alpha times the block spherical-output pressure, then taking spectral mesh to zero.

title: The thermodynamic pressure of every bounded Gaussian Ising perceptron activation

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every $\alpha>0$ and bounded Borel $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, with $M=\lfloor\alpha N\rfloor$ independent identically distributed standard Gaussian constraint rows $G_j$ and uniform Ising spins $\sigma$, does $N^{-1}\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{uniform\text{-}spin}}\exp(\sum_{j\leq M}f(G_j\cdot\sigma/\sqrt N))$ converge in mean and probability to $\inf_q\{\alpha V_f(q)+S_I(q)\}$, where $V_f$ and $S_I$ are the explicitly defined cavity and Ising entropy functionals, without assuming activation symmetry, concavity or smallness?

title: Universal gap and force exponents at negative spherical-perceptron jamming

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the negative-margin spherical perceptron at margin $-1$ and the small coordinate-mixture laws $\nu _\epsilon $ specified in the source, is there one satisfiability threshold $\alpha _c$ independent of epsilon, with the stated ordered critical limits for positive gaps and normalized contact forces? Ask for a force law of mean one without an atom at zero and exponents gamma,theta satisfying $\gamma =1/(2+\theta )$, $0.4126930<\gamma <0.4126934$, $0.4231063<\theta <0.4231088$, with $G_J(u)=u^(1-\gamma +o(1))$ and $F_J(s)=s^(1+\theta +o(1))$.

title: Finite critical two-point operator norm and nonuniqueness for nonamenable graphs

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every infinite connected locally finite nonamenable quasi-transitive graph, does independent bond percolation satisfy $p_c<p_{2\to 2}\leq p_u$ and have a bounded l2 two-point connectivity operator at $p_c$? Here $p_{2\to 2}$ is the supremum of p for which that operator is bounded, and $p_u$ is the uniqueness threshold. Include the stated simultaneous nonuniqueness interval for two parameter configurations.

title: A non-Gaussian massive continuum theory from the planar O(3) model

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the nearest-neighbor square-lattice O(3) spin model, can one choose dyadic $L>1$, $H>0$, $a_N=L^{-N}$, $\beta _N=H+(\log $ L)/(2pi)N+O(log(N+1)) and field factors $B_N$ so that all smeared field laws and Schwinger moments converge to an O(3)-invariant, Euclidean-invariant, reflection-positive clustering theory? Require factorial distribution bounds, reconstruction of a local unitary 1+1-dimensional theory with unique vacuum and positive spectral gap, and a nonzero connected four-point function on separated time supports.

title: An isolated lightest particle in the continuum O(3) spin field

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the canonical massive continuum O(3) spin field constructed from the planar lattice model, does the two-point spectral measure have the form $\rho =Z$ $\delta _{m_1^2}+\rho _rest$, with $m_1,Z,\delta >0$ and $supp(\rho _rest)$ contained in $[(m_1+\delta )^2,infinity)$?

title: The exact low-temperature transfer gap of the planar O(4) model

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the nearest-neighbor two-dimensional O(4) lattice model and its full transfer-gap mass $m_lat(\beta )$, is $lim_{\beta \to \infty }$ exp(pi $\beta )m_lat(\beta )/\operatorname{sqrt}(\beta )=32$ $\exp (\pi /4-1/2)$?

title: A GFF limit for triangular odd heights with two boundary arcs

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For uniform odd integer Lipschitz heights on triangular-lattice approximations of a smooth simply connected planar domain with the stated two-arc boundary data, does the height distribution converge to the harmonic boundary extension plus sigma times the domain GFF, for a universal $\sigma >0$, with convergence of every joint test-function moment and mean?

title: Critical nonpercolation on locally finite quasi-transitive graphs below one

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every infinite connected locally finite undirected quasi-transitive graph whose independent bond critical probability $p_c$ is less than one, does independent bond percolation at $p_c$ have no infinite open cluster almost surely?

title: A first-order temperature singularity for a stable radial continuum gas

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Does there exist a bounded continuous radial pair potential phi on $R^3$, stable in the sense $sum_{i<j}$ $\phi (|x_i-x_j|)\geq -BN$, with $|\phi (r)|\leq Cr^{-3-1/32}$, and a nonempty density interval I, such that one $\beta _c\in [7/8,9/8]$ is a strict temperature derivative jump of the finite canonical free-cube thermodynamic free energy for every $\rho \in I$?

title: A limiting density threshold for every fixed random clause size

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $k\geq 3$, do independent uniformly signed k-clauses using k distinct variables, sampled with replacement on n variables, have a constant $\alpha _k\in (0,infinity)$ such that satisfiability probability at floor(cn) clauses tends to one for every $c<\alpha _k$ and to zero for every $c>\alpha _k$?

title: Linear hitting-time variance for random clause size at least four

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $k\geq 4$, let $H_n$ be the first unsatisfiable time under independent proper uniformly signed k-clauses sampled with replacement. Is $Var(H_n)=Theta_k(n)$? Ask also $Var(min(H_n,floor(Bn)))=Theta_{k,B}(n)$ for $B>\log (2)/(-\log (1-2^{-k}))$.

title: Linear variance of the random 3-SAT unsatisfiability time

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Let $H_n$ be the first clause count at which sequential independent uniformly signed proper 3-clauses make an n-variable formula unsatisfiable. Are there absolute $c,C>0$ such that $cn\leq Var(H_n)\leq Cn$ for all sufficiently large n?

title: Interface and field scaling limits of triangular real Lipschitz surfaces

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For uniformly sampled real-valued triangular-lattice Lipschitz surfaces with the specified two-arc boundary values, do the distinguished interface and centered height field converge to chordal $SLE_4$ and sigma times the domain GFF? Require constants independent of the marked domain, $v=2/\operatorname{sqrt}(3)$, $\sigma ^2=1/(vA)$, $\lambda ^2=\pi /(8vA)$, and limiting mean lambda times the difference of the two boundary-arc harmonic measures.

title: Critical SK mixing, relaxation and log-Sobolev exponents

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For Gaussian SK at $\beta =1$ and each fixed total-variation threshold $\epsilon \in (0,1/2)$, are continuous-time mixing, relaxation and log-Sobolev constants $n^(2/3+o(1))$, while single-site discrete mixing is $n^(5/3+o(1))$, in probability over disorder?

title: A universal joint critical SK equilibrium and quench autocorrelation law

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: At SK critical $\beta =1$, do Gaussian and Rademacher couplings yield the same joint limiting continuous law for the precisely rescaled equilibrium autocorrelation $A_n(t)$ and quench autocorrelation $B_n(s,t)$, on positive-time compact sets? Ask for positive-time entrance densities $h_s$ selected by Gaussian dynamics, $h_{s+t}=S_t$ $h_s$, $h_s$ $Pi\to \delta _0$ as $s\downarrow 0$, $h_s\to 1$ in L1 as s$\to$infinity, and $B(s,t)\to A(t)$ locally uniformly in probability as waiting time s$\to$infinity.

title: Critical SK mixing lower bounds from realized Gibbs states

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: At Gaussian SK $\beta =1$, does the Gibbs probability of initial states whose continuous-time total-variation distance exceeds 1/4 at any deterministic $t_n=o(n^{2/3})$ tend to one in disorder probability? Ask for the same claim at $k_n=o(n^{5/3})$ single-site discrete updates.

title: Glauber cutoff throughout the high-temperature SK phase

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $0\leq \beta <1$, does worst-start heat-bath dynamics for Gaussian SK have total-variation cutoff at (log n)/(2lambda(beta)) in continuous site-rate-one time and at n times that scale in single-update discrete time, in disorder probability? Require a deterministic $\lambda (\beta )>0$, $\lambda (0)=1$, and $\lambda (\beta )\leq (1-\beta )^2$.

title: A size-independent Gibbs Poincaré constant throughout high-temperature SK

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every fixed $0\leq \beta <1$ in Gaussian zero-field SK, is there $C_\beta <infinity$ such that, with probability tending to one over disorder, $Var_\mu (f)\leq C_\beta $ D(f) simultaneously for every spin function? Equivalently, the single-site discrete heat-bath spectral gap is at least $1/(C_\beta $ n).

title: A limiting law for standardized low-temperature SK free energy

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For Gaussian zero-field SK at every fixed $\beta >1$, does the centered free energy divided by its own standard deviation converge in distribution through all n to a nondegenerate mean-zero variance-one law with a finite exponential moment near zero, uniquely specified by the limiting moment sequence?

title: The one-sixth free-energy fluctuation exponent in low-temperature SK

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $\beta >1$ in Gaussian zero-field SK, are $sd(F_n)=n^(1/6+o(1))$ and $Var(F_n)=n^(1/3+o(1))$? Require additionally that $|F_n-E$ $F_n|$ lies between $n^{1/6-\eta }$ and $n^{1/6+\eta }$ with probability tending to one for every $\eta >0$.

title: Stretched-exponential mixing barriers for typical low-temperature SK starts

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every fixed $\beta >1$ in Gaussian SK, does a starting configuration sampled from the realized Gibbs law still have conditional total-variation distance exceeding 1/4 at time $\exp (n^{1/10000})$, with joint disorder-and-start probability tending to one? Require both the source continuous and discrete update conventions.

title: A subexponential mixing bound from typical low-temperature SK starts

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every fixed $\beta >1$ in Gaussian SK, is there $c_\beta >0$ independent of n and realized disorder such that a Gibbs-sampled initial configuration has mixing time at most $\exp (n^{1-c_\beta })$, with joint probability tending to one?

title: A deterministic exact Hausdorff gauge for ordinary SLE

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each fixed $0<\kappa <8$, does there exist a deterministic continuous nondecreasing Hausdorff gauge $h_\kappa $ such that ordinary chordal $SLE_\kappa $ in the upper half-plane, parametrized by half-plane capacity 2t, has positive finite $h_\kappa -Hausdorff$ measure on every segment gamma([s,t]), simultaneously for all real $0<s<t<infinity$ almost surely?

title: The explicit logarithmic Hausdorff correction for SLE

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For fixed $0<\kappa <8$, put $d=1+\kappa /8$ and $h(r)=r^d(\log $ $\log (1/r))^((2-d)/2)$ near zero. Does ordinary chordal $SLE_\kappa $ have positive finite h-Hausdorff measure on every positive-time compact trace segment on one probability-one event, and finite expected h-measure of its entire trace in each deterministic bounded ball?

title: IID factors for invariant strongly Rayleigh laws on countable groups

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every countable group Gamma and every translation-invariant strongly Rayleigh probability law nu on ${0,1}^\Gamma $, does a Borel map from iid uniform labels to nu exist that commutes with every group translation on every label input?

title: Massive interface limits under thermal FK–Ising perturbation

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the specified thermally perturbed $q=2$ square-lattice FK–Ising model with nonzero fixed continuum mass, do Dobrushin interfaces converge along the full near-critical mesh scaling to the source-defined massive $SLE_{16/3}$ law, with the prescribed marked-domain and thermal-normalization conventions?

title: Logarithmic total-variation mixing of the physical Thorp shuffle

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the physical Thorp shuffle on $n=2^d$ cards from a deterministic deck, is the worst-start mixing time at total-variation distance 1/4 Theta(d)? Require a universal linear-in-d upper bound, uniformly over starts, together with the support lower bound $||q_d^{*t}-Uniform||_TV\geq 1-2^{tn/2}/n!$ for every integer $t\geq 0$.

title: The exact weak-recovery threshold for the symmetric three-community SBM

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the sparse equal-size three-community stochastic block model with within-community probability a/n and between-community probability b/n, is weak recovery possible exactly when $(a-b)^2>3(a+2b)$? Above this threshold require an O(n log n) algorithm achieving overlap at least 1/3+epsilon with probability tending to one; at or below it require every graph-based randomized estimator’s expected overlap to tend to 1/3.

title: Oracle-free computation of the limiting random 3-SAT threshold

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For independent proper uniformly signed random 3-clauses, is there a limiting sharp density $\alpha _3$ and one deterministic finite Turing machine that, on every unary precision input $1^r$, halts with a rational $q_r$ satisfying $|q_r-\alpha _3|\leq 2^{-r}$, using no oracle, advice or noncomputable parameter?

title: The exact three-state reconstruction threshold including equality

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the symmetric three-state broadcast channel with admissible $-$1/2$\leq$lambda$\leq$1, is reconstruction on every b-ary tree $b\geq 2$ and observed Poisson(d) offspring tree $d>1$ equivalent to d $\lambda ^2>1$, including antiferromagnetic parameters and nonreconstruction at equality?

title: A deterministic linear walk clock on tree-weighted planar maps

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the spanning-tree-weighted spherical n-edge planar-map ensemble, with degree probability measure and the spatial normalization specified by its metric limit, do the conditional walk path laws on every [0,T], accelerated by exactly n, converge jointly with the metric–measure map to the conditional Liouville Brownian motion law on the sqrt(2)-quantum sphere? The requested clock coefficient is one for the stated generator and continuum Dirichlet-form conventions.

title: Cardy crossing probabilities for Poisson–Voronoi percolation

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For critical planar Poisson–Voronoi percolation and every bounded Jordan quadrilateral, do annealed crossing probabilities converge at vanishing mesh to $integral_0^x$ $[u(1-u)]^{-2/3}du$ divided by $integral_0^1$ $[u(1-u)]^{-2/3}du$, where x is the conformal cross ratio of the marked sides?

title: Near-critical Voronoi universality conditional on Cardy limits

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Assuming critical Poisson–Voronoi crossing probabilities obey Cardy’s formula in all admissible quads, do the entire near-critical crossing ensembles, scaled by their own inverse expected pivotal counts, have quenched laws converging in probability to the same continuum law as independently normalized triangular site percolation? The conditional law averages coloring marks while keeping the Poisson geometry fixed.

title: The Voronoi pivotal-count amplitude under Cardy’s formula

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Assuming the stated full-domain Cardy crossing limit for critical Poisson–Voronoi percolation, does $\epsilon ^{3/4}$ E $N_\epsilon $ tend to a finite positive constant for the source-defined reference quad pivotal count?

title: A quenched SLE limit for weakly disordered FK–Ising interfaces

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the specified weak two-valued random-bond FK model at $q=2$ and its physical critical coupling, does the conditional interface law converge in bounded-Lipschitz distance, in probability over disorder, to $SLE_{16/3}$ for every sufficiently small fixed disorder and every admissible marked planar domain?

title: Conformal limits of all mixed Ising spin and energy correlations

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For a finite-range perturbation of the square-lattice Ising Hamiltonian by an admissible even interaction V, do all mixed bulk spin and energy correlations at one common critical $\beta _c(\lambda )$ converge for small |lambda| to the unperturbed conformal correlation functions, multiplied by nonzero spin and energy normalizations? Quantify every distinct interior point tuple, free or constant-spin boundary, and the infinite-plane periodic-box state, with conformal weights 1/8 for spins and 1 for energy.

title: SLE interfaces for weakly interacting planar Ising models

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For each admissible weak finite-range interaction of the nearest-neighbor square-lattice Ising model, does its Dobrushin interface at the physical critical coupling converge to chordal $SLE_3$ in every bounded marked Jordan domain along every admissible full mesh limit?

title: Quenched critical Ising interfaces under weak bond disorder

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For every bond-disorder law rho satisfying the manuscript stationarity, boundedness, finite-dependence and symmetry conditions, does sufficiently small fixed disorder $\epsilon >0$ produce a quenched Dobrushin critical interface law converging in bounded-Lipschitz distance, in probability over disorder, to chordal $SLE_3$ in every marked bounded Jordan domain and every admissible deterministic lattice approximation? Require a disorder threshold independent of the domain and $\beta _c^\rho (\epsilon )=\log (1+\operatorname{sqrt}(2))/2+O_\rho (\epsilon ^2)$.

title: Logarithmic relative fluctuations of disordered critical Ising correlations

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Assuming the deterministic reference-Ising bounds listed in the source, does the relative quenched two-spin fluctuation $R_\epsilon (r)$ of the planar two-valued weak random-bond model satisfy log $R_\epsilon (r)/\log $ log $r\to 1/4$ for every sufficiently small fixed $\epsilon >0$? Use the physical critical beta solving $sinh(2\beta (1-\epsilon ))sinh(2\beta (1+\epsilon ))=1$.

title: GFF limits of weighted integer Lipschitz surfaces

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the source-defined integer Lipschitz height model and each fixed $x\in [1/\operatorname{sqrt}(2),1]$, is there a positive normalization sigma(x), independent of the admissible bounded planar domain and its inside lattice approximation, such that the height distribution divided by sigma(x) converges to the domain GFF along the full mesh sequence, with every joint smooth-test moment?

title: Critical center magnetization in fixed-boundary XY boxes

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: Assuming the explicitly scoped height, renormalization and spin-field companion inputs, is the center magnetization $a_n$ in the critical planar XY fixed-boundary box asymptotic to A $n^{-1/8}(\log $ $n)^{1/16}$, for a positive model-dependent A?

title: The essential singularity of the planar XY correlation length

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: In the nearest-neighbor planar XY model below its physical inverse-temperature threshold $b_c$, does $\operatorname{sqrt}(b_c-b)$ log xi(b) converge to a finite strictly positive constant as b increases to $b_c$?

title: The logarithmic factor in critical planar XY correlations

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the nearest-neighbor planar XY model at its physical critical inverse temperature $b_c$, is its axial two-spin correlation $C_{b_c}(r)$ asymptotic to B $r^{-1/4}(\log $ $r)^{1/8}$, for an amplitude $B>0$ and integer $r\to \infty $?

title: The critical correlation power of the nearest-neighbor planar XY model

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the nearest-neighbor planar XY model at its physical critical inverse temperature, does log $C_{b_c}(r)/\log $ r tend to $-1/4$ along integer axial separations r$\to$infinity? This question asks only the power, without an amplitude limit or prescribed logarithmic factor.

title: The full critical XY spin-field limit with fixed boundary

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the fixed-boundary critical nearest-neighbor XY model in an admissible planar domain, does its normalized complex spin distribution converge along the entire mesh sequence in $H^{-3}_loc$ to the specified critical vertex field $V_*$? Require convergence of every finite collection of smooth compactly supported smearings, their conjugates, and all mixed nonnegative integer moments.

title: No infinite critical clusters for three-dimensional site and bond percolation

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For independent nearest-neighbor bond percolation and independent site percolation on $Z^3$ at their respective critical parameters, is the probability that the origin belongs to an infinite open cluster zero?

title: Finite conditional resolution of critical planar Ising stopping bands

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: For the critical nearest-neighbor zero-field Ising model on square lattices of mesh delta, with plus boundary in a fixed larger square $Q_L={z:||z||_infinity<L}$, fix $0<u<v<L$. In the inward case choose a compact target K inside $Q_u$; in the outward case choose K inside $Q_L$ minus the closure of $Q_v$. Require strictly positive distances from K to the band and fixed square boundary. Allow the two contour levels to be chosen in fixed open windows with disjoint closures, preserving these clearances. Fix a triangulation of each lattice face, linearly interpolate spins, and explore zero-level strands meeting the starting contour until their first return to that contour or first hit of the other contour, revealing the traversed triangle spins and starting-contour spins. Initially reveal the outside of the outer contour for an inward exploration, or the inside of the inner contour for an outward exploration. Is it true that for every $\epsilon ,\eta >0$ one can choose the levels and a finite list of deterministic regular Jordan barriers with finitely many plus/minus boundary arcs, all independent of the mesh, and a finite-valued descriptor of the band spins, so that for every sufficiently small delta the exceptional descriptor has probability at most epsilon, while for every realizable nonexceptional transcript inserting its descriptor-specific plus pins and then minus pins changes the entire conditional target spin law by summed total variation at most eta and yields the same final target-side law for every transcript with that descriptor? Require the descriptors of any fixed finite list of such bands to have convergent joint laws. Clearances and barriers are fixed before the mesh threshold, and the approximation is uniform over all bounded, including mesh-dependent, target observables.

title: Height-averaged logarithmic bridge-length windows for critical honeycomb self-avoiding walks

category.name: probability
category.description: Problems involving probability theory, stochastic processes, and random structures.

statement: On the honeycomb lattice with critical weight $X^length$, $X=(2+\operatorname{sqrt}(2))^{-1/2}$, use self-avoiding strict port-to-port bridges of integer height H and a fixed start per sum, with center-count length. Do there exist $c,C,h_0>0$ such that for all real $h>=h_0$ the summed mass, over $1<=H<=2h(\log $ $h)^{1/64}$, of bridges with length between $h^{4/3}(\log $ $h)^{-1/8}$ and $2h^{4/3}(\log $ $h)^{1/2}$ is at least c $h^{3/4}(\log $ $h)^{-C}$?

title: The Bochner-Riesz conjecture in dimension three

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every $1<p<infinity$, is the Fourier multiplier $(1-|\xi |^2/R^2)_+^\delta $ uniformly bounded on $L^p(R^3)$ for all $R>0$ whenever $\delta >max(3|1/p-1/2|-1/2,0)$, with the order-zero $L^2$ case also bounded?

title: Endpoint gradient regularity of the planar disk maximal operator

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For the centered Hardy-Littlewood maximal operator M over Euclidean disks in $R^2$, does every real f in $W^{1,1}(R^2)$ have M f in $W_loc^{1,1}(R^2)$ and ||gradient M $f||_L1$ $<=$ C||gradient $f||_L1$ for one absolute C?

title: Critical L3 local smoothing in three dimensions

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every $\epsilon >0$, does the half-wave propagator satisfy ||exp(it $\operatorname{sqrt}(-Delta))f||_L3(R3$ x $[1,2])<=C_\epsilon ||(1-Delta)^{\epsilon /2}f||_L3(R3)$ for every Schwartz f?

title: Diagonal extension from positively curved surfaces in R3

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every compact smooth positively curved surface Sigma in $R^3$, allowing a smooth boundary, and every $p>3$, is its surface extension operator bounded from $L^p(Sigma)$ to $L^p(R^3)$?

title: Avoiding every dyadic affine sequence in a large-measure set

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every $\eta\in(0,1)$, does some compact $E\subset[0,1]$ of Lebesgue measure greater than $1-\eta$ avoid containing $\{a+b2^{-n}:n\geq1\}$ for every real $a$ and every nonzero real $b$?

title: Almost everywhere Fourier convergence for L log L

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every complex function f on the circle with integral |f| log(2+|f|) finite, do the symmetric Fourier partial sums $S_N$ f converge to f almost everywhere as N ranges through all positive integers?

title: Avoiding every geometric affine sequence in a large-measure set

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every $q\in(0,1)$ and $\eta\in(0,1)$, does some compact $E\subset[0,1]$ of Lebesgue measure greater than $1-\eta$ avoid containing $\{a+bq^n:n\geq1\}$ for every real $a$ and every nonzero real $b$ of either sign?

title: Hausdorff dimension of four-dimensional Kakeya sets

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Must every subset E of $R^4$ that contains a unit line segment in every direction have Hausdorff dimension four?

title: Three-dimensional Kakeya maximal estimate

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For delta in (0,1), define $K_\delta $ f(v) as the supremum of the averages of |f| over radius-delta, length-one tubes directed along v in $S^2$. For every $\epsilon >0$, is $||K_\delta $ $f||_L3(S2)$ $<=$ $C_\epsilon $ $\delta ^{-\epsilon }||f||_L3(R3)$, with $C_\epsilon $ independent of f and delta?

title: The inverse-first-power universal integral-means spectrum

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For injective holomorphic maps f from the unit disk into the unit disk, let $\beta _f(-1)=\limsup _{r->1}$ $\log (integral_0^{2\pi }$ |f'(r exp(i $\theta ))|^{-1}$ dtheta)/log(1/(1-r)), and let $B_b(-1)$ be the supremum of $\beta _f(-1)$ over that class. Is $B_b(-1)=1/4$?

title: Nearly minimal Littlewood maxima with positive minima

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every $\eta >0$, do all sufficiently large integer lengths N admit a polynomial with N real sign coefficients whose modulus is at least sqrt(N)/16 and at most (1+eta)sqrt(N) everywhere on the unit circle?

title: Uniformly flat real Littlewood polynomials

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every epsilon in (0,1), is there N0 such that for every integer $N>=N0$ one can choose N real coefficients, each +1 or -1, so that the modulus of their polynomial is between (1-epsilon)sqrt(N) and (1+epsilon)sqrt(N) at every point of the unit circle?

title: Rigidity of circle domains with removable boundary

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: If every sphere homeomorphism conformal off the boundary of a circle domain D is a Mobius map, must every conformal bijection from D to another circle domain be the restriction of a Mobius map?

title: Schrodinger convergence at the higher-dimensional endpoint

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every integer $n>=3$ and every f in $H^(n/(2(n+1)))(R^n)$, does its Schrodinger evolution, interpreted as the limit of Gaussian frequency regularizations, admit a representative converging to f almost everywhere as time decreases to zero?

title: Planar Schrodinger convergence at H one-third

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For every f in $H^{1/3}(R^2)$, does its Schrodinger evolution, interpreted as the limit of Gaussian frequency regularizations, admit a representative converging to f almost everywhere as time decreases to zero?

title: Sharp L-infinity extension from the two-sphere

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: Let E $g(x)=integral_S2$ g(omega) exp(2pi i x dot omega) d sigma(omega). For every $p>3$, is there $C_p$ with ||E $g||_Lp(R3)<=C_p||g||_Linfinity(S2)$ for all bounded measurable g?

title: Annular variation of the triangular Hilbert transform

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For F,G in $L^3(R^2)$, write $B_{a,b}(F,G)(x,y)=integral_{a<|t|<b}$ F(x+t,y) G(x,y+t) dt/t. For every $r>2$, is the $L^{3/2}$ norm of the supremum of $(sum_j$ $|B_{a_j,b_j}(F,G)|^r)^{1/r}$, over finite disjoint ordered positive annuli, at most $C_r||F||_3||G||_3$?

title: The symmetric maximal triangular Hilbert transform

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For F,G in $L^3(R^2)$, is $||sup_{0<a<b<infinity}$ $|integral_{a<|t|<b}$ F(x+t,y)G(x,y+t) dt/t| $||_L(3/2)(R2)$ $<=$ $C||F||_3||G||_3$ with one absolute C?

title: Balanced L3 boundedness of the trilinear Hilbert transform

category.name: analysis
category.description: Limits, continuity, calculus, and function theory.

statement: For Schwartz functions f1,f2,f3 on R, let $T(f1,f2,f3)(x)=pv$ integral f1(x+t)f2(x+2t)f3(x+3t) dt/t. Is $||T(f1,f2,f3)||_L1$ $<=$ C $product_j$ $||fj||_L3$ for one finite absolute C?

title: Polynomial switch-chain mixing for all degree sequences

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every graphical degree sequence of a finite simple undirected n-vertex graph, does the lazy degree-preserving switch chain on all its labeled realizations mix to its uniform stationary law in polynomial time, with $t_mix\leq 2n^{8}$ and gap at least $[24n^{2}\cdot binom(n,4)]^{-1}$ whenever there is more than one realization?

title: Matrix-multiplication improvement over every field

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed field F, is its square arithmetic matrix-multiplication exponent strictly below 2.371054887, without a characteristic restriction?

title: Exact uniform sampling of arbitrary-margin contingency tables

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For all nonnegative integer row and column margins of equal total N, is exact uniform sampling of nonnegative integer contingency tables possible with independent unbiased random bits, almost-sure termination and polynomial expected bit time in dimensions and log(N+1)? Is total-variation error $2^{-k}$ achievable in bounded polynomial time in those parameters and k?

title: Bounded additive gap for the bin-packing configuration LP

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Is there one absolute additive constant bounding $OPT-LP$ for every rational bin-packing instance, even when every item exceeds 1/6 and the configuration LP treats individual item copies as separate objects?

title: FPRAS for cell-bounded contingency tables

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For arbitrary binary nonnegative row and column margins and binary upper bounds on every cell, is there one randomized relative counting scheme using polynomial worst-case bit time in total input length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, with failure probability $\delta $ and certain zero output for emptiness, without a counting or sampling oracle?

title: FPRAS for common integer polymatroid bases

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Given value oracles for two integer polymatroid rank functions on n elements with binary-encoded capacities and compatible base totals, can one estimate the number of common nonnegative integral base vectors within relative error $\varepsilon $ and failure $\delta $ using polynomially many oracle calls and bit operations in n, total encoding length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, including a certain zero answer for emptiness?

title: FPRAS for common matroid bases

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Given only independence oracles for any two equal-rank matroids on n labeled elements, can one estimate their number of common bases to relative error $\varepsilon $ with failure $\delta $ using polynomially many oracle calls and other bit operations in n, parameter encoding length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, with certain zero output when none exist?

title: Complex square and rectangular multiplication bounds

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Over C, do the arithmetic matrix-multiplication exponents satisfy $\omega <2.258$, the dual rectangular exponent $\alpha >0.465$, and $w(0.709)<2.092$, using exact arithmetic operations?

title: Complex matrix multiplication at exponent nine-fourths

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Can square complex matrices be multiplied in $O_\varepsilon (n^{9/4+\varepsilon })$ arithmetic operations for every fixed $\varepsilon >0$, equivalently is the complex matrix-multiplication exponent at most 9/4?

title: Hellinger contraction with biased Boolean outputs

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every Boolean f on a uniform n-dimensional discrete cube and every correlation $\rho \in [-1,1]$, is $H(Ef)-E$ $H(T_\rho f)\leq 1-H(\rho )$, where $H(a)=\surd (1-a^{2})$ and $T_\rho $ is coordinatewise noise?

title: Sharp binary-channel information contraction on the cube

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Let X be uniform on ${-1,1}^n$, $u:{-1,1}^n\to [-1,1]$, and $Y\in {-1,1}$ have conditional mean u(X). If $T_\rho $ independently flips cube coordinates with correlation $\rho $, must $I(T_\rho u)\leq \psi (|\rho |\psi ^{-1}(I(u)))$ for all $-1\leq \rho \leq 1$, where $I(u)=h(Eu)-E$ h(u), h(a) is the binary entropy of (1+a)/2, and $\psi (a)=\log $ $2-h(a)$?

title: Constant-factor hardness of directed feedback vertex set

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed $A\geq 1$, is finding a directed feedback vertex set within factor A NP-hard on explicitly given unweighted digraphs, with a positive threshold and a deterministic polynomial-time gap reduction?

title: Almost-linear edit-distance approximation scheme

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed rational $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$, is there one randomized logarithmic-word RAM algorithm returning a $(1+\varepsilon )-multiplicative$ upper estimate of ordinary string edit distance with probability $\geq 2/3$ and worst-case expected running time $N^{1+o(1)}$ in total string length N, including all preprocessing, with exact zero output on equal strings?

title: Counting-hierarchy upper bound for existential-universal real sentences

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Does one fixed finite level of the counting hierarchy decide every existential-universal sentence over the reals encoded by Boolean combinations of sign tests on integer arithmetic-circuit polynomials, with signed binary constants and only addition, subtraction and multiplication gates, independent of variable counts, degrees and coefficient magnitudes?

title: Explicit super-square-root-exponential depth-three circuits

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Is there a language in deterministic polynomial time whose n-variable membership functions require depth-three OR–AND–OR Boolean circuits of size $>2^{A\surd n}$ for every fixed $A>0$ and every sufficiently large n, with unrestricted bottom fan-in and no circuit uniformity condition?

title: Memory–precision lower bounds for exact Gaussian regression

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed finite $A>0$, do there exist constants $c_A>0$ and $d_A>=2$ such that the following holds for every $d>=d_A$, integer $0<=M<=Ad^2$, and $0<\epsilon <=1/10$? A jointly measurable one-pass learner has at most $2^M$ persistent states and must stop by a prescribed deterministic finite horizon T. Its independent observations are Gaussian rows $x_t$ with distribution $N(0,I_d)$ and exact labels $<x_t,S>$, where S is an independent uniform unit vector. The data-free shared seed and initial state, and fresh transition randomness, are independent of these data. If its output unit vector estimates S within angle epsilon with probability at least 2/3, must $T>=c_A$ d log(1/epsilon)? Transitions may use the current observation and index but retain only the next state; stopping output uses the terminal state, index and fresh randomness only, and discarded observations cannot be revisited.

title: Unconditional time lower bounds for fixed-dimensional WL

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Are there $c>0,k_{0}$ such that, for every fixed $k\geq k_{0}$, every correct deterministic decider of k-WL equivalence has worst-case time at least $n^{ck}$ for every sufficiently large n, even on connected simple uncolored graphs of diameter $\leq 2$, for both joint and separate refinement on multitape machines or the specified sequential logarithmic-word RAM?

title: FPRAS for perfect matchings in general graphs

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Can the number of perfect matchings of an arbitrary explicitly given finite general graph be estimated to relative error $\varepsilon $ with failure probability $\delta $ in worst-case bit time polynomial in input length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, with zero returned certainly when there are no perfect matchings?

title: Quasipolynomial trace samples for arbitrary symbols

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement:
Let $n\ge2$ and $0<p\le1$. A deletion trace retains each symbol of a length-$n$ string independently with probability $p$, reports retained symbols exactly and preserves their order. The decoder knows $n,p$ and receives independent traces. Does there exist an absolute $C>0$ and a decoder recovering every input string with probability at least $2/3$ from at most
\[
 \left\lceil\exp\bigl(Cp^{-1}(\log n)^3(1+\log\log(2n))^6\bigr)\right\rceil
\]
traces? The symbols need not be binary. No restriction is placed on the decoder's computational cost.

title: Depth-five homogeneous lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Must every syntactically homogeneous depth-five $\Sigma \Pi \Sigma \Pi \Sigma $ circuit over C computing the (1,1) entry of a product of n independent n×n variable matrices have size at least $n^{c\surd n}$ for some $c>0$ and all sufficiently large n?

title: Integer multiplication below n log n

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Is there a uniform exact deterministic multitape Turing-machine algorithm multiplying n-bit binary integers in O(n(log $n)^{1-2^{-182}})$ bit operations, for all sufficiently large n?

title: Exponential semidefinite complexity for perfect matching

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed shift $\rho \in (0,1)$, do the matrices indexed by odd vertex sets U and perfect matchings M, with entry $|M\cap \delta (U)|-1+\rho $, where $\delta (U)$ is the set of edges crossing U, of complete graphs on even n vertices require real positive-semidefinite factorization rank at least $2^{cn}$, for one $c>0$ independent of $\rho $ and all sufficiently large n depending on $\rho $? This also asks for the resulting exponential exact semidefinite-lift lower bound.

title: Optimal Max-Cut approximation hardness

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed $\alpha $ greater than the Goemans–Williamson constant and at most 1, is achieving approximation factor $\alpha $ for Max-Cut NP-hard even on finite simple unweighted graphs?

title: Quasipolynomial mean-payoff/parity winning sets

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Can the winning states for a conjunction of mean-payoff and parity objectives in an explicitly encoded finite turn-based game be computed deterministically in quasipolynomial time in its binary input length?

title: Metric k-median at factor one plus two over e

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed $\varepsilon >0$, is there a deterministic polynomial-bit-time algorithm for arbitrary finite rational metric k-median that opens at most k facilities and achieves approximation ratio $1+2/e+\varepsilon $?

title: Metric k-median strictly below factor two

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Is there one absolute $\sigma >0$ and a randomized polynomial-bit-time algorithm for arbitrary finite rational metric k-median that opens at most k facilities and achieves ratio $2-\sigma $ in expectation and with failure probability at most $(|clients|+|facilities|+2)^{-a}$ for any prescribed fixed $a>0$?

title: Constant-factor hardness of Min-UnCut

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every fixed integer $K\geq 2$, can 3SAT be reduced deterministically in polynomial time to an explicit finite simple unweighted graph and positive integer threshold k so that satisfiable inputs have minimum uncut-edge count $\leq k$ and unsatisfiable inputs have count $>Kk$?

title: Hitting lists for noncommutative rational formulas

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: Can polynomial bit time in unary n,s produce a polynomial-size list of rational matrix n-tuples such that every nonzero admissible size-s free rational formula has a defined evaluation with invertible value at some list member, uniformly over arbitrary rational constants and inverse depth, without receiving the formula?

title: One-sample matroid prophet selection

category.name: computer_science
category.description: Computational complexity, algorithms, and theoretical CS.

statement: For every finite known matroid with mutually independent nonnegative weights and one independent sample from each unknown marginal law, can a distribution-free online selector achieve one fixed positive fraction of expected offline optimum, even when the measurable arrival order depends on both samples, all realized weights and the selector’s random seed? The expected optimum is assumed finite and no running-time restriction is imposed.
